local function v_u_168(p153, p154, p155) -- name: detourAroundOwner

function v_u_42.SetPaused(p482, p483) -- name: SetPaused
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_31, (copy) v_u_22, (copy) v_u_66
	local v484 = v_u_31[p482]
	if v484 then
		v484.Paused = p483
		if p483 then
			if v484.MoodHandler and v484.MoodHandler.activeMood then
				v484.MoodHandler:RequestInterrupt()
				if v484.IsOwner and not v484.MoodStopRequested then
					v_u_22:FireServer()
					v484.MoodStopRequested = true
				end
			end
			if v484.State ~= "Idle" then
				local v485 = v484.State
				v484.State = "Idle"
				local v486 = v_u_66(v484)
				if v484.CurrentAnimation then
					v484.CurrentAnimation:Stop()
				end
				local v487 = v484.Animations[v486]
				if v487 then
					v487:Play()
					v484.CurrentAnimation = v487
				end
				if v485 == "Jumping" then
					local v488 = v484.RootPart:FindFirstChild("Land")
					if v488 and v488:IsA("Sound") then
						v488:Play()
					end
				end
			end
		else
			local v489 = v484.CurrentAnimation
			for _, v490 in v484.Animations do
				if v490 == v489 then
					continue
				end
				v490:Stop(0)
			end
			if v489 then
				v489:Play(0)
			end
			return
		end
	else
		return
	end
end

function v_u_42.AttachHat(p_u_496, _, p497, p498, p_u_499) -- name: AttachHat
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_119

		return nil
	end
	local v_u_501 = v500:GetAttribute("HatScale") or 1
	local v502 = v_u_10.Get(p497)

	if v502 then
		v503 = v502.Asset

	end

		p497 = v503.Name

	local v506 = v504(v505, p497)

	end
	local v_u_507 = v506:Clone()
	for _, v508 in v_u_507:GetDescendants() do
		if not v508:IsA("BaseScript") then
			continue
		end
		v508:Destroy()
	end
	local v_u_509 = v_u_507:GetScale()
	local v_u_510 = v_u_507.PrimaryPart
	local v_u_511 = v_u_510:FindFirstChild("HatAttachment")
	if not v_u_511 and (v502 and v502.Grip) then
		v_u_511 = Instance.new("Attachment")
		v_u_511.Name = "HatAttachment"
		v_u_511.CFrame = v502.Grip
		v_u_511.Parent = v_u_510
	end
	if v502 and (v502.HaloColored and p_u_499) then
		local function v514() -- name: tint
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_499, (copy) v_u_507
			local v512 = p_u_499:GetAttribute("HaloColor")
			if typeof(v512) == "Color3" then
				for _, v513 in v_u_507:QueryDescendants(".HaloColorablePart") do
					if v513:IsA("BasePart") then
						v513.Color = v512
					elseif v513:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or v513:IsA("Beam") then
						v513.Color = ColorSequence.new(v512)
					else
						if not v513:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
							continue
						end

					end
				end
			end

function v_u_9._TickFlight(p59, p60) -- name: _TickFlight
	local v61 = p59.flight

			v61.target = v62
		end
		v61.elapsed = v61.elapsed + p60
		local v63 = v61.elapsed / v61.duration
		local v64 = math.min(v63, 1)
		local v65 = v64 * v64 * (3 - v64 * 2)
		local v66 = p59.companion
		local v67 = v61.startPos:Lerp(v61.target, v65)
		local v68 = v65 * 12 * (1 - v65)
		v66.MoodPositionOverride = v67 + Vector3.new(0, v68, 0)

				v69()
			end
		end
	end
end

function v_u_9.StartMood(p77, p78, p79) -- name: StartMood
	p77.activeMood = p78
	p77.moodStartTime = tick()
	p77.departing = false
	p77._headRestEnded = false
	p77._spinEnded = false
	p77._danceEnded = false
	p77._wanderEnded = false
	if p78 == "HeadRest" then
		p77:StartHeadRest()
		return
	elseif p78 == "SpinBurst" then
		p77:StartSpinBurst()

function v_u_9.UpdateMood(p80, p81) -- name: UpdateMood
	if p80.flight == nil and not (p80.resting or (p80.departing or (p80.danceActive or p80.wandering))) then
		p80:_TickMovement(p81)
	end
	p80:_TickFlight(p81)
	p80:_TickRest(p81)
	p80:_TickSpin(p81)
	p80:_TickDance(p81)
	return (p80._headRestEnded or (p80._spinEnded or (p80._danceEnded or p80._wanderEnded))) and true or false
end
function v_u_9.StopMood(p82) -- name: StopMood
	if p82.activeMood then
		if p82.activeMood == "HeadRest" then
			p82:CleanupHeadRest()
		elseif p82.activeMood == "SpinBurst" then
			p82:CleanupSpinBurst()
		elseif p82.activeMood == "Dance" then
			p82:CleanupDance()
		elseif p82.activeMood == "Wander" then
			p82:CleanupWander()
		end
		p82.activeMood = nil
	end
end

function v_u_9.EnterHeadRestPhase(p_u_84, p85) -- name: EnterHeadRestPhase

	p_u_84.headRestPhaseGen = p_u_84.headRestPhaseGen + 1
	local v_u_86 = p_u_84.headRestPhaseGen
	if p85 == "FlyTo" then
		local v87 = p_u_84:_GetHeadRestPosition()

			p_u_84:_PlayFirstAvailable(v_u_5)

				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_84
				return p_u_84:_GetHeadRestPosition()

					v88 = p_u_84.headRestPhaseGen == v_u_86

				end
			end)
		else

	elseif p85 == "Rest" then

			p_u_84:_PlayFirstAvailable(v_u_6)

		end

			p_u_84.resting = false
			p_u_84.departing = true
			p_u_84:SetParticles("Sleep/Particle", false)
			p_u_84:_DetachFromHead()
			p_u_84:StopFlight()
			p_u_84:SetState("Walking")
			p_u_84:_PlayFirstAvailable(v_u_5)
			local v89 = p_u_84.companion.RootPart
			if v89 then
				p_u_84.companion.LastPosition = v89.Position
			end
			p_u_84.companion.PositionVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
			p_u_84.companion.AnchorPosition = nil
			p_u_84.companion.IsFollowing = false
			local v90 = p_u_84:_GetReturnPosition()

				p_u_84.companion.MoodPositionOverride = nil
				p_u_84.companion.MoodSmoothTime = nil

							v92 = p_u_84.headRestPhaseGen == v_u_86
						else
							v92 = false

function v_u_9._TickRest(p93, p94) -- name: _TickRest
	if p93.resting then
		local v95 = p93:_GetHead()
		local v96 = p93.restAttachment
		if v95 and (v95.Parent and (v96 and v96.Parent)) then
			p93.restElapsed = p93.restElapsed + p94
			local v97 = p93:_GetOwnerRootPosition()
			local v98 = p93.restStartOwnerPos

function v_u_9._TickSpin(p103, p104) -- name: _TickSpin
	if p103.spinning then
		p103.spinElapsed = p103.spinElapsed + p104
		local v105 = p103.spinElapsed / 0.9
		local v106 = math.min(v105, 1)
		local v107 = 1 - (1 - v106) ^ 3
		local v108 = p103.spinStartYaw + v107 * 2 * 3.141592653589793 * 2
		local v109 = CFrame.Angles(0, v108, 0)
		local v110 = p103.companion.RootPart
		v110.CFrame = CFrame.new(v110.Position) * v109 * CFrame.Angles(0, 3.141592653589793, 0)
		p103.companion.TargetRotation = v109

			p103.spinning = false
			p103._spinEnded = true

function v_u_9.StartDance(p112) -- name: StartDance
	if p112.companion.Animations.Dance then
		local v113 = p112:_GetOwnerRootPosition()
		if v113 then
			p112:SetState("MoodAction")
			p112:StopMoving()
			local v114 = p112.companion.RootPart
			local v115 = (v114.Position - v113) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
			if v115.Magnitude < 0.1 then
				p112.danceAngle = math.random() * 3.141592653589793 * 2
				p112.danceRadius = 5
			else
				local v116 = v115.Z
				local v117 = v115.X
				p112.danceAngle = math.atan2(v116, v117)
				p112.danceRadius = v115.Magnitude
			end
			p112.danceTargetRadius = 5 + math.random() * 2
			p112.danceYOffset = v114.Position.Y - v113.Y
			local _, v118 = v114.CFrame:ToOrientation()
			p112.danceSpin = v118
			p112.danceDirection = math.random() > 0.5 and 1 or -1
			p112.danceBobPhase = 0
			p112.danceElapsed = 0
			p112.danceActive = true
			p112:PlayAnimation("Dance")
		else
			p112._danceEnded = true
		end
	else
		p112._danceEnded = true
		return
	end
end
function v_u_9._TickDance(p119, p120) -- name: _TickDance
	if p119.danceActive then
		local v121 = p119:_GetOwnerRootPosition()
		if v121 then
			p119.danceElapsed = p119.danceElapsed + p120
			p119.danceAngle = p119.danceAngle + p120 * 1.2566370614359172 * p119.danceDirection
			p119.danceSpin = p119.danceSpin + p120 * 1.0471975511965976 * p119.danceDirection
			p119.danceBobPhase = p119.danceBobPhase + p120 * 3
			local v122 = p120 * 4
			local v123 = math.min(v122, 1)
			p119.danceRadius = p119.danceRadius + (p119.danceTargetRadius - p119.danceRadius) * v123
			p119.danceYOffset = p119.danceYOffset + (2.5 - p119.danceYOffset) * v123
			local v124 = p119.danceBobPhase
			local v125 = math.sin(v124) * 0.25
			local v126 = p119.danceAngle
			local v127 = math.cos(v126) * p119.danceRadius
			local v128 = p119.danceYOffset + v125
			local v129 = p119.danceAngle
			local v130 = math.sin(v129) * p119.danceRadius
			local v131 = v121 + Vector3.new(v127, v128, v130)
			local v132 = p119.companion.RootPart
			local v133 = CFrame.Angles(0, p119.danceSpin, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 3.141592653589793, 0)
			v132.CFrame = CFrame.new(v131) * v133
			p119.companion.TargetRotation = v133
			if p119.danceElapsed >= 8 then
				p119.danceActive = false
				p119:_StartDanceReturn()
			end
		else
			p119.danceActive = false
			p119._danceEnded = true
		end
	else
		return
	end
end

function v_u_9._GetWanderTarget(p139) -- name: _GetWanderTarget
	if #p139.wanderSpots > 0 then
		p139.wanderSpotIndex = p139.wanderSpotIndex + 1
		local v140 = p139.wanderSpots[p139.wanderSpotIndex]
		if v140 then
			return v140 + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
		else
			return nil
		end
	else
		if p139.wanderLegsLeft <= 0 then
			return nil
		end
		p139.wanderLegsLeft = p139.wanderLegsLeft - 1
		local v141 = p139:_GetOwnerRootPosition()
		if not v141 then
			return nil
		end
		local v142 = math.random() * 3.141592653589793 * 2
		local v143 = 5 + math.random() * 6
		local v144 = 2 + math.random() * 3
		local v145 = math.cos(v142) * v143
		local v146 = math.sin(v142) * v143
		return v141 + Vector3.new(v145, v144, v146)
	end
end

function v_u_9.EnterWanderPhase(p_u_149, p150) -- name: EnterWanderPhase

	p_u_149.wanderPhaseGen = p_u_149.wanderPhaseGen + 1
	local v_u_151 = p_u_149.wanderPhaseGen
	local function v153() -- name: stillValid

		local v152

			v152 = p_u_149.wanderPhaseGen == v_u_151

			v152 = false
		end

	end
	if p150 == "FlyToNext" then
		local v154 = p_u_149:_GetWanderTarget()
		if v154 then
			p_u_149:_PlayFirstAvailable(v_u_5)
			p_u_149:StartFlight(v154, nil, function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_149, (copy) v_u_151
				local v155
				if p_u_149.activeMood == "Wander" then
					v155 = p_u_149.wanderPhaseGen == v_u_151
				else
					v155 = false
				end

					p_u_149:EnterWanderPhase("Pause")
				end
			end)
		else
			p_u_149:EnterWanderPhase("Return")
		end
	elseif p150 == "Pause" then
		p_u_149:_PlayFirstAvailable(v_u_7)
		local v156 = 0.6 + math.random() * 1.4
		task.delay(v156, function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_149, (copy) v_u_151
			local v157
			if p_u_149.activeMood == "Wander" then
				v157 = p_u_149.wanderPhaseGen == v_u_151
			else
				v157 = false
			end
			if v157 then
				p_u_149:EnterWanderPhase("FlyToNext")
			end
		end)
	elseif p150 == "Return" then
		p_u_149.wandering = false
		p_u_149:_FlyBackToFollow(v153, function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_149
			p_u_149._wanderEnded = true
		end)
	end
end

				v_u_84:PivotTo(v_u_82.WorldCFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, 1.5707963267948966, 0))
				local v86 = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
				v86.Part0 = v85
				v86.Part1 = v_u_84.PrimaryPart
				v86.Parent = v_u_84.PrimaryPart
				v_u_84.Name = "OllieHeldFish"
				v_u_84.Parent = p_u_79.companion.Model
				p_u_79.heldFishModel = v_u_84
				task.delay(p_u_81, function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_79, (ref) v_u_84
					if p_u_79.heldFishModel == v_u_84 then
						p_u_79:RemoveHeldFish()
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
	end
end
function v_u_10.RemoveHeldFish(p87) -- name: RemoveHeldFish
	if p87.heldFishModel and p87.heldFishModel.Parent then
		p87.heldFishModel:Destroy()
	end
	p87.heldFishModel = nil
end
function v_u_10.Update(p88, p89) -- name: Update
	if p88.activeMood then
		return nil
	end
	p88.chatterTimer = p88.chatterTimer + p89
	if p88.chatterTimer >= p88.chatterNext then
		p88.chatterTimer = 0
		p88.chatterNext = math.random(60, 120)
		p88:PlayCuteSound()
	end
	local v90 = p88.companion.State
	if v90 == "Walking" or v90 == "Jumping" then
		p88.idleTimer = 0
		if p88.heldFishModel then
			p88:RemoveHeldFish()
		end
		return nil
	end
	p88.idleTimer = p88.idleTimer + p89
	if p88.idleTimer >= 300 then
		p88.idleTimer = 0
		return "IdleSleep"
	end
	local v91 = p88:RollMoods(p89)
	if not v91 then
		return nil
	end
	p88.idleTimer = 0
	return v91
end
function v_u_10.StartMood(p92, p93, p94) -- name: StartMood
	p92.activeMood = p93
	p92.moodStartTime = tick()
	p92._wanderEnded = false
	p92._sillySitEnded = false
	p92._snapEnded = false
	p92._reelSwimEnded = false
	p92._attackEnded = false
	p92._fetchEnded = false
	if p93 == "Wander" then
		p92:StartWander(p94, false)
		return
	elseif p93 == "Sleep" then
		p92:StartWander(p94, true)
		return
	elseif p93 == "IdleSleep" then
		p92:StartIdleSleep()
		return
	elseif p93 == "SillySit" then
		p92:StartSillySit()
		return
	elseif p93 == "Snap" then
		p92:StartSnap()
		return
	elseif p93 == "ReelSwim" then
		p92:StartReelSwim()
		return
	elseif p93 == "PlayerAttack" then
		p92:StartPlayerAttack(p94)
	elseif p93 == "Fetch" then
		p92:StartFetch(p94)
	end
end
function v_u_10.UpdateMood(p95, p96) -- name: UpdateMood
	if not p95.arcActive and (not p95.reelSwimCircling and (p95.waterSwim == nil and (p95.snapHoldCFrame == nil and p95.fetchHoldCFrame == nil) and p95.settleState == nil)) then
		p95:_TickMovement(p96)
	end
	p95:_TickArc(p96)
	p95:_TickWaterSwim(p96)
	p95:_TickReelSwim(p96)
	if p95.activeMood == "Fetch" and not (p95.arcActive or (p95.reelSwimCircling or p95.settleState)) then
		if p95:_GetBobberPosition() then
			p95.fetchBobberMissingSince = nil
		elseif p95.fetchBobberMissingSince then
			if tick() - p95.fetchBobberMissingSince > 0.5 then
				p95.fetchBobberMissingSince = nil
				p95.fetchPhaseGen = p95.fetchPhaseGen + 1
				p95.fetchHoldCFrame = nil
				p95:_ResumeReelPresence()
			end
		else
			p95.fetchBobberMissingSince = tick()
		end
	end
	if p95.activeMood == "Snap" and (p95.snapHoldCFrame and not p95.arcActive) then
		p95.companion.RootPart.CFrame = p95.snapHoldCFrame
	end
	if p95.activeMood == "Fetch" and (p95.fetchHoldCFrame and not p95.arcActive) then
		p95.companion.RootPart.CFrame = p95.fetchHoldCFrame
	end
	local v97 = p95.settleState
	if v97 then
		v97.elapsed = v97.elapsed + p96
		local v98 = v97.elapsed / 0.25
		local v99 = math.min(v98, 1)
		p95.companion.RootPart.CFrame = v97.startCF:Lerp(v97.targetCF, v99)
		if v99 >= 1 then
			local v100 = v97.onComplete
			p95.settleState = nil
			if v100 then
				v100()
			end
		end
	end
	return p95.activeMood == "PlayerAttack" and tick() - p95.moodStartTime > 8 and true or (p95.activeMood == "Fetch" and (not p95.reelSwimCircling and tick() - p95.moodStartTime > 60) and true or ((p95._wanderEnded or (p95._sillySitEnded or (p95._snapEnded or (p95._reelSwimEnded or (p95._attackEnded or p95._fetchEnded))))) and true or false))
end
function v_u_10.StopMood(p101) -- name: StopMood
	if p101.activeMood then
		if p101.activeMood == "Wander" or p101.activeMood == "Sleep" then
			p101:CleanupWander()
		elseif p101.activeMood == "IdleSleep" then
			p101:CleanupIdleSleep()
		elseif p101.activeMood == "SillySit" then
			p101:CleanupSillySit()
		elseif p101.activeMood == "Snap" then
			p101:CleanupSnap()
		elseif p101.activeMood == "ReelSwim" then
			p101:CleanupReelSwim()
		elseif p101.activeMood == "PlayerAttack" then
			p101:CleanupPlayerAttack()
		elseif p101.activeMood == "Fetch" then
			p101:CleanupFetch()
		end
		p101.activeMood = nil
	end
end
function v_u_10.RequestInterrupt(p102) -- name: RequestInterrupt
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	p102.idleTimer = 0
	v_u_3.RequestInterrupt(p102)
end
function v_u_10.OnPhase(p103, p104, _) -- name: OnPhase
	if p104 == "Grab" and p103.activeMood == "Fetch" then
		p103:EnterFetchPhase("Grab")
	end
end
function v_u_10.StartWander(p105, p106, p107) -- name: StartWander
	p105:SetState("MoodAction")
	p105.wanderSpots = p106.WanderSpots or {}
	p105.wanderNapSpot = p106.NapSpot
	p105.wanderSpotIndex = 0
	p105.wanderShouldNap = p107
	if #p105.wanderSpots == 0 then
		p105._wanderEnded = true
	else
		if not p105.heldFishModel and math.random(1, 100) <= 20 then
			p105:SpawnHeldFish()
		end
		p105:EnterWanderPhase("WalkToNextSpot")
	end
end
function v_u_10.EnterWanderPhase(p_u_108, p109) -- name: EnterWanderPhase
	p_u_108.wanderPhaseGen = p_u_108.wanderPhaseGen + 1
	local v_u_110 = p_u_108.wanderPhaseGen
	if p109 == "WalkToNextSpot" then
		p_u_108.wanderSpotIndex = p_u_108.wanderSpotIndex + 1
		if p_u_108.wanderSpotIndex > #p_u_108.wanderSpots then
			if p_u_108.wanderShouldNap then
				p_u_108:EnterWanderPhase("WalkToNapSpot")
			else
				p_u_108._wanderEnded = true
			end
		else
			p_u_108:MoveTo(p_u_108.wanderSpots[p_u_108.wanderSpotIndex], {
				["speed"] = 7,
				["animation"] = nil,
				["arriveRadius"] = 1.5,
				["onArrive"] = nil,
				["animation"] = p_u_108:GetWalkAnimation(),
				["onArrive"] = function() -- name: onArrive
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_108, (copy) v_u_110
					local v111
					if p_u_108.activeMood == "Wander" or p_u_108.activeMood == "Sleep" then
						v111 = p_u_108.wanderPhaseGen == v_u_110
					else
						v111 = false
					end
					if v111 then
						p_u_108:EnterWanderPhase("PauseAtSpot")
					end
				end
			})
			return
		end
	elseif p109 == "PauseAtSpot" then
		p_u_108:StopMoving()
		p_u_108:PlayAnimation("SitIdle")
		if math.random(1, 100) <= 15 then
			p_u_108:PlayCuteSound()
		end
		local v112 = 0.4 + math.random() * 0.9999999999999999
		task.delay(v112, function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_108, (copy) v_u_110
			local v113
			if p_u_108.activeMood == "Wander" or p_u_108.activeMood == "Sleep" then
				v113 = p_u_108.wanderPhaseGen == v_u_110
			else
				v113 = false
			end
			if v113 then
				p_u_108:EnterWanderPhase("WalkToNextSpot")
			end
		end)
		return
	elseif p109 == "WalkToNapSpot" then
		if p_u_108.wanderNapSpot then
			p_u_108:MoveTo(p_u_108.wanderNapSpot, {
				["speed"] = 7,
				["animation"] = nil,
				["arriveRadius"] = 1.5,
				["onArrive"] = nil,
				["animation"] = p_u_108:GetWalkAnimation(),
				["onArrive"] = function() -- name: onArrive
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_108, (copy) v_u_110
					local v114
					if p_u_108.activeMood == "Wander" or p_u_108.activeMood == "Sleep" then
						v114 = p_u_108.wanderPhaseGen == v_u_110
					else
						v114 = false
					end
					if v114 then
						p_u_108:EnterWanderPhase("SitBeforeNap")
					end
				end
			})
		else
			p_u_108._wanderEnded = true
		end
	elseif p109 == "SitBeforeNap" then
		p_u_108:StopMoving()
		p_u_108:PlayAnimation("SitIdle")
		local v115 = 1.2 + math.random() * 1.3
		task.delay(v115, function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_108, (copy) v_u_110
			local v116
			if p_u_108.activeMood == "Wander" or p_u_108.activeMood == "Sleep" then
				v116 = p_u_108.wanderPhaseGen == v_u_110
			else
				v116 = false
			end
			if v116 then
				p_u_108:EnterWanderPhase("Nap")
			end
		end)
	elseif p109 == "Nap" then
		p_u_108:StopMoving()
		p_u_108:SetState("Sleeping")
		p_u_108:PlayAnimation("Sleep")
		p_u_108:SetParticles("Sleep/Particle", true)
		p_u_108:PlaySound("Snore")
		task.delay(45, function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_108, (copy) v_u_110
			local v117
			if p_u_108.activeMood == "Wander" or p_u_108.activeMood == "Sleep" then
				v117 = p_u_108.wanderPhaseGen == v_u_110
			else
				v117 = false
			end
			if v117 then
				p_u_108._wanderEnded = true
			end
		end)
	end
end
function v_u_10.CleanupWander(p118) -- name: CleanupWander
	p118:StopMoving()
	p118:SetParticles("Sleep/Particle", false)
	p118:StopSound("Snore")
	p118:RemoveHeldFish()
	p118.wanderSpots = {}
	p118.wanderNapSpot = nil
	p118.wanderSpotIndex = 0
	p118.wanderShouldNap = false
	p118._wanderEnded = false
end

	p119:SetState("Sleeping")
	p119:PlayAnimation("Sleep")
	p119:SetParticles("Sleep/Particle", true)
	p119:PlaySound("Snore")
end
function v_u_10.CleanupIdleSleep(p120) -- name: CleanupIdleSleep
	p120:SetParticles("Sleep/Particle", false)
	p120:StopSound("Snore")
end
function v_u_10.StartSillySit(p_u_121) -- name: StartSillySit
	p_u_121:SetState("MoodAction")
	p_u_121:StopMoving()
	p_u_121:PlayAnimation("SillySit")
	p_u_121:PlayCuteSound()
	p_u_121.sillySitPhaseGen = p_u_121.sillySitPhaseGen + 1
	local v_u_122 = p_u_121.sillySitPhaseGen
	local v123 = 3 + math.random() * 3
	task.delay(v123, function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_121, (copy) v_u_122
		if p_u_121.activeMood == "SillySit" and p_u_121.sillySitPhaseGen == v_u_122 then
			p_u_121._sillySitEnded = true
		end
	end)
end
function v_u_10.CleanupSillySit(p124) -- name: CleanupSillySit
	p124:StopMoving()
	p124._sillySitEnded = false
end
function v_u_10._IsReelPresenceMood(p125) -- name: _IsReelPresenceMood
	return (p125.activeMood == "ReelSwim" or p125.activeMood == "Snap") and true or p125.activeMood == "Fetch"
end
function v_u_10._GetCircleAngleFromPosition(p126) -- name: _GetCircleAngleFromPosition
	local v127 = p126.companion.RootPart.Position - p126.reelSwimBobberPos
	local v128 = v127.X
	if math.abs(v128) < 0.001 then
		local v129 = v127.Z
		if math.abs(v129) < 0.001 then
			return math.random() * 3.141592653589793 * 2
		end
	end
	local v130 = v127.Z
	local v131 = v127.X
	return math.atan2(v130, v131)
end
function v_u_10._ResumeReelPresence(p132) -- name: _ResumeReelPresence
	p132:StopWaterSwim()
	p132.companion.MoodUninterruptible = false
	local v133 = p132:_GetBobberPosition()
	if v133 then
		p132.reelSwimBobberPos = v133
		local v134 = ((p132.companion.RootPart.Position - v133) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude - 6
		if math.abs(v134) > 1.5 then
			p132:EnterReelSwimPhase("SwimToCircle")
		else
			p132:EnterReelSwimPhase("Circle")
		end
	else
		p132:EnterReelSwimPhase("ArcOut")
		return
	end
end
function v_u_10.StartReelSwim(p135) -- name: StartReelSwim
	local v136 = p135:_GetBobberPosition()
	if v136 then
		p135:SetState("MoodAction")
		p135.reelSwimBobberPos = v136
		p135.reelSwimDir = math.random() > 0.5 and 1 or -1
		local v137 = p135.companion.RootPart.Position
		if (v137 - v136).Magnitude > 10 then
			p135.reelReturnPos = v137
			p135:EnterReelSwimPhase("ArcIn")
		else
			p135:_ResumeReelPresence()
		end
	else
		p135._reelSwimEnded = true
		return
	end
end
function v_u_10.EnterReelSwimPhase(p_u_138, p139) -- name: EnterReelSwimPhase
	p_u_138.reelSwimPhaseGen = p_u_138.reelSwimPhaseGen + 1
	local v_u_140 = p_u_138.reelSwimPhaseGen
	if p139 == "ArcIn" then
		local v141 = p_u_138:_GetCircleAngleFromPosition()
		local v142 = p_u_138.reelSwimBobberPos
		local v143 = math.cos(v141) * 6
		local v144 = math.sin(v141) * 6
		p_u_138:StartArc(v142 + Vector3.new(v143, 0, v144), function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_138, (copy) v_u_140
			local v145 = p_u_138:_IsReelPresenceMood()
			if v145 then
				v145 = p_u_138.reelSwimPhaseGen == v_u_140
			end
			if v145 then
				p_u_138:EnterReelSwimPhase("Circle")
			end
		end)
		return
	elseif p139 == "SwimToCircle" then
		local v146 = p_u_138:_GetCircleAngleFromPosition()
		local v147 = p_u_138.reelSwimBobberPos
		local v148 = math.cos(v146) * 6
		local v149 = math.sin(v146) * 6
		p_u_138:StartWaterSwim(v147 + Vector3.new(v148, 0, v149), 9, function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_138, (copy) v_u_140
			local v150 = p_u_138:_IsReelPresenceMood()
			if v150 then
				v150 = p_u_138.reelSwimPhaseGen == v_u_140
			end
			if v150 then
				p_u_138:EnterReelSwimPhase("Circle")
			end
		end)
		return
	elseif p139 == "Circle" then
		p_u_138:StopMoving()
		p_u_138.reelSwimAngle = p_u_138:_GetCircleAngleFromPosition()
		p_u_138.reelSwimBobberMissingSince = nil
		p_u_138.reelSwimCircling = true
		p_u_138:PlayAnimation(p_u_138:GetSwimAnimation())
		return
	elseif p139 == "ArcOut" then
		p_u_138.reelSwimCircling = false
		p_u_138:StopMoving()
		local v151 = p_u_138.companion.Owner.Character
		if v151 then
			v151 = v151:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		end
		local v152 = p_u_138.reelReturnPos
		if v152 then
			v151 = v152
		elseif v151 then
			v151 = v151.Position
		end
		if v151 then
			p_u_138:StartArc(v151, function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_138, (copy) v_u_140
				local v153 = p_u_138:_IsReelPresenceMood()
				if v153 then
					v153 = p_u_138.reelSwimPhaseGen == v_u_140
				end
				if v153 then
					p_u_138:EnterReelSwimPhase("Settle")
				end
			end, nil, "Land")
		else
			p_u_138._reelSwimEnded = true
		end
	else
		if p139 == "Settle" then
			p_u_138:_StartSettleToOwner(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_138, (copy) v_u_140
				local v154 = p_u_138:_IsReelPresenceMood()
				if v154 then
					v154 = p_u_138.reelSwimPhaseGen == v_u_140
				end
				if v154 then
					p_u_138._reelSwimEnded = true
				end
			end)
		end
		return
	end
end
function v_u_10._TickReelSwim(p155, p156) -- name: _TickReelSwim
	if p155.reelSwimCircling then
		local v157 = p155:_GetBobberPosition()
		if v157 then
			if p155.reelSwimBobberMissingSince then
				p155.reelSwimBobberMissingSince = nil
				p155.reelSwimBobberPos = v157
				p155.reelSwimAngle = p155:_GetCircleAngleFromPosition()
			end
		elseif p155.reelSwimBobberMissingSince then
			if tick() - p155.reelSwimBobberMissingSince > 0.5 then
				p155.reelSwimBobberMissingSince = nil
				p155:EnterReelSwimPhase("ArcOut")
				return
			end
		else
			p155.reelSwimBobberMissingSince = tick()
		end
		p155.reelSwimAngle = p155.reelSwimAngle + p156 * 1.5 * p155.reelSwimDir
		local v158 = p155.reelSwimAngle
		local v159 = p155.reelSwimBobberPos
		local v160 = math.cos(v158) * 6
		local v161 = math.sin(v158) * 6
		local v162 = v159 + Vector3.new(v160, 0, v161)
		local v163 = -math.sin(v158)
		local v164 = math.cos(v158)
		local v165 = Vector3.new(v163, 0, v164) * p155.reelSwimDir
		p155.companion.RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(v162, v162 + v165) * CFrame.Angles(0, 3.141592653589793, 0)
	end
end
function v_u_10._CleanupReelPresence(p166) -- name: _CleanupReelPresence
	p166:StopWaterSwim()
	p166.reelSwimCircling = false
	p166.reelSwimBobberMissingSince = nil
	p166.settleState = nil
	p166._reelSwimEnded = false
end
function v_u_10.CleanupReelSwim(p167) -- name: CleanupReelSwim
	p167:StopArc()
	p167:StopMoving()
	p167:_CleanupReelPresence()
end
function v_u_10.StartSnap(p168) -- name: StartSnap
	p168:SetState("MoodAction")
	p168:EnterSnapPhase("Dash")
end
function v_u_10.EnterSnapPhase(p_u_169, p170) -- name: EnterSnapPhase
	p_u_169.snapPhaseGen = p_u_169.snapPhaseGen + 1
	local v_u_171 = p_u_169.snapPhaseGen
	if p170 == "Dash" then
		local v172 = p_u_169:_GetBobberPosition()
		if v172 then
			p_u_169.reelSwimCircling = false
			p_u_169.reelSwimBobberPos = v172
			p_u_169:StartWaterSwim(v172, 14, function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_169, (copy) v_u_171
				local v173
				if p_u_169.activeMood == "Snap" then
					v173 = p_u_169.snapPhaseGen == v_u_171
				else
					v173 = false
				end
				if v173 then
					p_u_169.snapHoldCFrame = p_u_169.companion.RootPart.CFrame
					p_u_169:EnterSnapPhase("Bite")
				end
			end)
		else
			p_u_169._snapEnded = true
		end
	else
		if p170 == "Bite" then
			task.delay(0.3, function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_169, (copy) v_u_171
				local v174
				if p_u_169.activeMood == "Snap" then
					v174 = p_u_169.snapPhaseGen == v_u_171
				else
					v174 = false
				end
				if v174 then
					p_u_169:PlayAnimation("Bite")
					p_u_169:PlaySound("Angry", true)
					task.delay(0.8, function()
						-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_169, (ref) v_u_171
						local v175
						if p_u_169.activeMood == "Snap" then
							v175 = p_u_169.snapPhaseGen == v_u_171
						else
							v175 = false
						end
						if v175 then
							p_u_169.snapHoldCFrame = nil
							p_u_169:_ResumeReelPresence()
						end
					end)
				end
			end)
		end
		return
	end
end
function v_u_10.CleanupSnap(p176) -- name: CleanupSnap
	p176:StopArc()
	p176:StopMoving()
	p176.snapHoldCFrame = nil
	p176:_CleanupReelPresence()
end
function v_u_10.StartPlayerAttack(p177, p178) -- name: StartPlayerAttack
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	local v179 = p178.TargetUserId
	if typeof(v179) == "number" then
		p177.attackTarget = v_u_2:GetPlayerByUserId(v179)
		if p177:_GetTargetRootPart() then

function v_u_22._BuildItemModel(p45, p46) -- name: _BuildItemModel
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5
	local v47 = v_u_5.getAsync("item", p46)
	if not v47 then
		return nil
	end
	local v48 = p45:_ResolveItemAsset(v47, p46)
	if not v48 then
		return nil
	end
	local v49 = v48:Clone()
	local v50 = v49.PrimaryPart or v49:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
	if not v50 then
		v49:Destroy()

	end
	v49.PrimaryPart = v50
	for _, v51 in v49:GetDescendants() do
		if v51:IsA("Script") or v51:IsA("LocalScript") then
			v51:Destroy()

			end

			v51.CanCollide = false
			v51.CanQuery = false
			v51.CanTouch = false
			v51.Massless = true
			v51.CastShadow = false
		end
	end
	for _, v52 in v49:GetDescendants() do
		if not v52:IsA("BasePart") or v52 == v50 then
			continue
		end
		local v53 = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		v53.Part0 = v50
		v53.Part1 = v52
		v53.Parent = v50
	end
	p45:_FitHeldModel(v49)

end
function v_u_22._FitHeldModel(_, p54) -- name: _FitHeldModel
	local v55 = p54:GetExtentsSize()
	local v56 = v55.X
	local v57 = v55.Y
	local v58 = v55.Z
	local v59 = math.max(v56, v57, v58)
	if v59 <= 0 then
		return
	elseif v59 > 3 then
		p54:ScaleTo(3 / v59 * p54:GetScale())
	elseif v59 < 1 then
		p54:ScaleTo(1 / v59 * p54:GetScale())
	end
end

function v_u_22.SpawnHeldItem(p_u_62, p_u_63, p_u_64) -- name: SpawnHeldItem
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11
	local v_u_65 = p_u_62:_FindHoldAttachment()
	if not v_u_65 then
		return false
	end
	p_u_62:ClearHeldModel()
	local v_u_66 = p_u_62.diveHeldGen
	task.spawn(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_64, (copy) p_u_62, (copy) p_u_63, (copy) v_u_66, (copy) v_u_65, (ref) v_u_11
		local v67

			v67 = p_u_62:_BuildFishModel(p_u_63)
		else
			v67 = p_u_62:_BuildItemModel(p_u_63)
		end

			if p_u_64 then
				v67 = p_u_62:_BuildItemModel(p_u_63)
			else
				v67 = p_u_62:_BuildFishModel(p_u_63)
			end
		end
		if v67 and v67.PrimaryPart then
			if p_u_62.diveHeldGen == v_u_66 and v_u_65.Parent then
				local v68 = v_u_65.Parent
				v67:PivotTo(v_u_65.WorldCFrame * v_u_11)
				local v69 = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
				v69.Part0 = v68
				v69.Part1 = v67.PrimaryPart
				v69.Parent = v67.PrimaryPart
				v67.Name = "ScrapBotHeldItem"
				v67.Parent = p_u_62.companion.Model
				p_u_62.diveHeldModel = v67
			else
				v67:Destroy()
			end
		else
			local v70 = p_u_64
			warn((("[ScrapBot] no held model built for \"%*\" (isFish=%*)"):format(p_u_63, (tostring(v70)))))
			return
		end
	end)
	return true
end

function v_u_22._MaxSearchDepth(_, p77) -- name: _MaxSearchDepth

function v_u_22._FindWaterVolume(p79, p80) -- name: _FindWaterVolume
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_12
	local v81 = workspace:FindFirstChild("zones")
	if v81 then
		v81 = v81:FindFirstChild("fishing")
	end
	if not v81 then
		return nil
	end
	v_u_12.FilterDescendantsInstances = { v81 }
	local v82 = (1 / 0)
	local v83 = nil
	for _, v84 in workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(p80, 60, v_u_12) do
		local v85 = v84.Size * 0.5
		local v86 = v84.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(p80)
		local v87 = v86.X
		local v88 = -v85.X
		local v89 = v85.X
		local v90 = math.clamp(v87, v88, v89)
		local v91 = v86.Y
		local v92 = -v85.Y
		local v93 = v85.Y
		local v94 = math.clamp(v91, v92, v93)
		local v95 = v86.Z
		local v96 = -v85.Z
		local v97 = v85.Z
		local v98 = math.clamp(v95, v96, v97)
		local v99 = Vector3.new(v90, v94, v98)
		local v100 = v84.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(v99)
		local v101 = (v100 - p80).Magnitude
		if v82 <= v101 then
			continue
		end
		local v102 = v84.CFrame
		local v103 = v99.X
		local v104 = v85.Y
		local v105 = v99.Z
		local v106 = v102:PointToWorldSpace((Vector3.new(v103, v104, v105)))
		local v107 = v106.Y
		local v108 = p79:_GetFloorY(v106, v84.Size.Y)
		local v109 = v108 or v107 - v84.Size.Y
		if v107 - v109 < 4 then
			continue
		end
		v83 = {
			["Zone"] = v84,
			["Point"] = v100,
			["SurfaceY"] = v107,
			["FloorY"] = v109,
			["HasFloor"] = v108 ~= nil
		}
		v82 = v101
	end
	return v83
end

function v_u_22._DiveEntryPoint(p138) -- name: _DiveEntryPoint
	local v139 = p138.diveVolume
	local v140 = p138.companion.RootPart.Position
	local v141
	if v139 then
		v141 = v139.SurfaceY
	else
		v141 = p138.diveWaterTarget.Y
	end
	local v142 = (p138.diveWaterTarget - v140) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
	local v143
	if v142.Magnitude < 1 then
		local v144 = math.random() * 3.141592653589793 * 2
		local v145 = math.cos(v144)
		local v146 = math.sin(v144)
		v143 = Vector3.new(v145, 0, v146)
	else
		v143 = v142.Unit
	end
	local v147 = p138.diveWaterTarget + v143 * 8
	if v139 then
		v147 = p138:_ClampToZone(v139, v147)
	end
	local v148 = v147.X
	local v149 = v141 + -0.5
	local v150 = v147.Z
	return Vector3.new(v148, v149, v150)
end

function v_u_22._RollSearchDepth(p169, p170) -- name: _RollSearchDepth
	local v171 = p170.FloorY + 2
	local v172 = p170.SurfaceY - 2
	if v172 <= v171 then
		return v171
	else
		local v173 = p169:_MaxSearchDepth(p170)
		local v174 = math.min(3, v173)
		local v175 = p170.SurfaceY - v174
		local v176 = math.clamp(v175, v171, v172)
		local v177 = p170.SurfaceY - v173
		local v178 = math.clamp(v177, v171, v172)
		if v176 <= v178 then
			return v176
		else
			return v178 + math.random() * (v176 - v178)
		end
	end
end
function v_u_22._RollSearchPoint(p179) -- name: _RollSearchPoint
	local v180 = math.random() * 3.141592653589793 * 2
	local v181 = 4 + math.random() * 4
	local v182 = p179.diveWaterTarget
	local v183 = math.cos(v180) * v181
	local v184 = math.sin(v180) * v181
	local v185 = v182 + Vector3.new(v183, 0, v184)
	local v186 = p179.diveVolume
	if not v186 then
		return v185
	end
	if not p179.diveSubmerged then
		local v187 = v185.X
		local v188 = p179:_RollSearchDepth(v186)
		local v189 = v185.Z
		return Vector3.new(v187, v188, v189)
	end
	local v190 = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 4
	local v191 = p179.diveWaterTarget.Y + v190
	local v192 = v186.FloorY + 2
	local v193 = v186.SurfaceY - 2
	local v194 = math.clamp(v191, v192, v193)
	local v195 = v185.X
	local v196 = v185.Z
	return Vector3.new(v195, v194, v196)
end
function v_u_22.StartArc(p197, p198, p199, p200, p201) -- name: StartArc
	p197:StopMoving()
	local v202 = p197.companion.RootPart.Position
	local v203 = (p198 - v202).Magnitude
	p197.arcActive = true
	p197.arcStart = v202
	p197.arcTarget = p198
	if not p200 then
		local v204 = v203 * 0.4
		p200 = math.clamp(v204, 5, 16)
	end
	p197.arcHeight = p200
	p197.arcLandSound = p201 or "Dive"
	local v205 = v203 / 22
	p197.arcDuration = math.max(v205, 0.9)
	p197.arcElapsed = 0
	p197.arcOnComplete = p199
	if p197:_UseHoldAnimation() then
		p197:PlayAnimation("HoldItem")
	else
		p197:PlayAnimation(p197.companion.Animations.Jump and "Jump" or p197:GetWalkAnimation())
	end
	p197:PlaySound("Jump", true)
	p197:EmitParticles("jump", 5)
end
function v_u_22.StopArc(p206) -- name: StopArc
	p206.arcActive = false
	p206.arcOnComplete = nil
end
function v_u_22._TickArc(p207, p208) -- name: _TickArc
	if p207.arcActive then
		p207.arcElapsed = p207.arcElapsed + p208
		local v209 = p207.arcElapsed / p207.arcDuration
		local v210 = math.min(v209, 1)
		local v211 = p207.arcStart:Lerp(p207.arcTarget, v210)
		local v212 = 4 * p207.arcHeight * v210 * (1 - v210)
		local v213 = v211 + Vector3.new(0, v212, 0)
		local v214 = (p207.arcTarget - p207.arcStart) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
		if v214.Magnitude > 0.001 then
			p207.companion.RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(v213, v213 + v214.Unit) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0)
		else
			p207.companion.RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(v213) * p207.companion.RootPart.CFrame.Rotation
		end
		if v210 >= 1 then
			local v215 = p207.arcOnComplete
			p207:StopArc()
			p207:PlaySound(p207.arcLandSound, true)
			if p207.arcLandSound == "Dive" then
				p207:EmitParticles("splash", 5)
			end
			if v215 then
				v215()
			end
		end
	end
end

function v_u_22._TickWaterSwim(p222, p223) -- name: _TickWaterSwim
	local v224 = p222.waterSwim
	if v224 then
		local v225 = v224.trackFn and v224.trackFn()
		if v225 then
			v224.target = v225
		end
		local v226 = v224.target - v224.position
		local v227 = v226.Magnitude
		local v228 = v224.speed * p223
		if v227 <= v228 then
			v224.position = v224.target
		else
			v224.position = v224.position + v226.Unit * v228
		end
		local v229 = p222.companion.RootPart
		local v230 = v226.X
		local v231 = v226.Z
		local v232 = Vector3.new(v230, 0, v231)
		if v232.Magnitude > 0.001 then
			local v233 = v232.Magnitude * 0.8390996311772799
			local v234 = v226.X
			local v235 = v226.Y
			local v236 = -v233
			local v237 = math.clamp(v235, v236, v233)
			local v238 = v226.Z
			local v239 = Vector3.new(v234, v237, v238).Unit
			v229.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(v224.position, v224.position + v239) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0)
		else
			v229.CFrame = CFrame.new(v224.position) * v229.CFrame.Rotation
		end
		if v227 <= v224.arriveRadius then
			local v240 = v224.onArrive
			p222.waterSwim = nil
			if v240 then
				v240()
			end
		end
	end
end
function v_u_22._StartSettleToOwner(p241, p242) -- name: _StartSettleToOwner
	local v243 = p241.companion.RootPart
	local v244 = v243.CFrame
	local v245 = p241:_OwnerPosition()
	local v246
	if v245 then
		local v247 = (v245 - v243.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
		if v247.Magnitude > 0.001 then
			v246 = CFrame.lookAt(v243.Position, v243.Position + v247.Unit) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0)
		else
			v246 = v244
		end
	else
		v246 = v244
	end
	p241.settleState = {
		["elapsed"] = 0,
		["startCF"] = nil,
		["targetCF"] = nil,
		["onComplete"] = nil,
		["startCF"] = v244,
		["targetCF"] = v246,
		["onComplete"] = p242
	}
end
function v_u_22._TickSettle(p248, p249) -- name: _TickSettle
	local v250 = p248.settleState
	if v250 then
		v250.elapsed = v250.elapsed + p249
		local v251 = v250.elapsed / 0.25
		local v252 = math.min(v251, 1)
		p248.companion.RootPart.CFrame = v250.startCF:Lerp(v250.targetCF, v252)
		if v252 >= 1 then
			local v253 = v250.onComplete
			p248.settleState = nil
			if v253 then
				v253()
			end
		end
	end
end
function v_u_22.Update(p254, p255) -- name: Update
	if p254.activeMood then
		return nil
	else
		local v256 = p254.companion.State
		if v256 == "Walking" or v256 == "Jumping" then
			return nil
		else
			return p254:RollMoods(p255)
		end
	end
end
function v_u_22.StartMood(p257, p258, p259) -- name: StartMood
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10
	p257.activeMood = p258
	p257.moodStartTime = tick()
	p257._wanderEnded = false
	p257._diveEnded = false
	p257._emoteEnded = false
	if p258 == "Wander" then
		p257:StartWander(p259)
		return
	elseif p258 == "Dive" then
		p257:StartDive(p259)
		return
	elseif p258 == "Dance" then
		p257:StartDance()
		return
	elseif p258 == "Confused" then
		p257:StartConfused()
	elseif v_u_10[p258] then
		p257:StartEmote(p258)
	end
end
function v_u_22.UpdateMood(p260, p261) -- name: UpdateMood
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10
	if not p260.arcActive and (not p260.danceActive and (p260.waterSwim == nil and p260.diveHoldCFrame == nil and p260.settleState == nil)) then
		p260:_TickMovement(p261)
	end
	p260:_TickArc(p261)
	p260:_TickWaterSwim(p261)
	p260:_TickSettle(p261)
	p260:_TickDance(p261)
	if p260.diveHoldCFrame and not (p260.arcActive or p260.settleState) then
		p260.diveHoverPhase = p260.diveHoverPhase + p261 * 2.5
		local v262 = p260.diveHoverPhase
		local v263 = math.sin(v262) * 0.35
		p260.companion.RootPart.CFrame = p260.diveHoldCFrame + Vector3.new(0, v263, 0)
	end
	if p260.activeMood == "Dive" then
		if p260.diveSearching and not p260.diveGrabbed then
			local v264 = p260.diveGrabAt
			if v264 and v264 <= workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then
				p260:EnterDivePhase("Grab")
			end
		end
		if (p260.divePayload == "Fish" or p260.divePayload == "Refine") and not p260.diveGrabbed then
			local v265 = p260:_ResolveHitbox()
			local v266 = p260:_OwnerDistance()
			local v267
			if v266 == nil then
				v267 = false
			else
				v267 = v266 > 60
			end
			if v265 and not v267 then
				p260.diveTargetLostSince = nil
			elseif p260.diveTargetLostSince then
				if tick() - p260.diveTargetLostSince > 0.5 then
					p260:EnterDivePhase("SwimBack")
				end
			else
				p260.diveTargetLostSince = tick()
			end
		end
		if tick() - p260.moodStartTime > 45 then
			return true
		end
	end
	return v_u_10[p260.activeMood] and tick() - p260.moodStartTime > 20 and true or ((p260._wanderEnded or (p260._diveEnded or p260._emoteEnded)) and true or false)
end
function v_u_22.StopMood(p268) -- name: StopMood
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10
	if p268.activeMood then
		if p268.activeMood == "Wander" then
			p268:CleanupWander()
		elseif p268.activeMood == "Dive" then
			p268:CleanupDive()
		elseif p268.activeMood == "Dance" then
			p268:CleanupDance()
		elseif p268.activeMood == "Confused" then
			p268:CleanupConfused()
		elseif v_u_10[p268.activeMood] then
			p268:CleanupEmote()
		end
		p268.activeMood = nil
	end
end
function v_u_22.OnPhase(p269, p270, _) -- name: OnPhase
	if p270 == "Grab" and p269.activeMood == "Dive" then
		p269:EnterDivePhase("Grab")
	end
end
function v_u_22.RequestInterrupt(p271) -- name: RequestInterrupt
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	if p271.danceActive then
		p271.danceActive = false
		p271:PlayAnimation(p271:GetWalkAnimation())
	end
	v_u_3.RequestInterrupt(p271)
end
function v_u_22.StartEmote(p_u_272, p_u_273) -- name: StartEmote
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10
	local v274 = v_u_10[p_u_273]
	if v274 and p_u_272.companion.Animations[v274] then
		p_u_272:StopMoving()
		p_u_272:SetState("MoodAction")
		p_u_272:SetFaceOwner(true)
		p_u_272:PlayAnimation(v274)
		p_u_272.emotePhaseGen = p_u_272.emotePhaseGen + 1
		local v_u_275 = p_u_272.emotePhaseGen
		local v276 = 4 + math.random() * 3
		task.delay(v276, function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_272, (copy) p_u_273, (copy) v_u_275
			if p_u_272.activeMood == p_u_273 and p_u_272.emotePhaseGen == v_u_275 then
				p_u_272._emoteEnded = true
			end
		end)
	else
		p_u_272._emoteEnded = true
	end
end
function v_u_22.CleanupEmote(p277) -- name: CleanupEmote
	p277.emotePhaseGen = p277.emotePhaseGen + 1
	p277:StopMoving()
	p277:SetFaceOwner(false)
	p277._emoteEnded = false
end
function v_u_22.StartDance(p278) -- name: StartDance
	if p278.companion.Animations.Dance then
		local v279 = p278:_OwnerPosition()
		if v279 then
			p278:StopMoving()
			p278:SetState("MoodAction")
			p278:SetFaceOwner(false)
			local v280 = p278.companion.RootPart
			local v281 = (v280.Position - v279) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
			if v281.Magnitude < 0.1 then
				p278.danceAngle = math.random() * 3.141592653589793 * 2
				p278.danceRadius = 5
			else
				local v282 = v281.Z
				local v283 = v281.X
				p278.danceAngle = math.atan2(v282, v283)
				p278.danceRadius = v281.Magnitude
			end
			p278.danceTargetRadius = 5 + math.random() * 2
			p278.danceYOffset = v280.Position.Y - v279.Y
			local _, v284 = v280.CFrame:ToOrientation()
			p278.danceSpin = v284
			p278.danceDirection = math.random() > 0.5 and 1 or -1
			p278.danceBobPhase = 0
			p278.danceElapsed = 0
			p278.danceActive = true
			p278:PlayAnimation("Dance")
		else
			p278._emoteEnded = true
		end
	else
		p278._emoteEnded = true
		return
	end
end
function v_u_22._TickDance(p285, p286) -- name: _TickDance
	if p285.danceActive then
		local v287 = p285:_OwnerPosition()
		if v287 then
			p285.danceElapsed = p285.danceElapsed + p286
			p285.danceAngle = p285.danceAngle + p286 * 1.2566370614359172 * p285.danceDirection
			p285.danceSpin = p285.danceSpin + p286 * 1.0471975511965976 * p285.danceDirection
			p285.danceBobPhase = p285.danceBobPhase + p286 * 3
			local v288 = p286 * 4
			local v289 = math.min(v288, 1)
			p285.danceRadius = p285.danceRadius + (p285.danceTargetRadius - p285.danceRadius) * v289
			p285.danceYOffset = p285.danceYOffset + (0 - p285.danceYOffset) * v289
			local v290 = p285.danceBobPhase
			local v291 = math.sin(v290) * 0.25
			local v292 = p285.danceAngle
			local v293 = math.cos(v292) * p285.danceRadius
			local v294 = p285.danceYOffset + v291
			local v295 = p285.danceAngle
			local v296 = math.sin(v295) * p285.danceRadius
			local v297 = v287 + Vector3.new(v293, v294, v296)
			local v298 = p285.companion.RootPart
			local v299 = CFrame.Angles(0, p285.danceSpin, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0)
			v298.CFrame = CFrame.new(v297) * v299
			p285.companion.TargetRotation = v299
			if p285.danceElapsed >= 10 then
				p285.danceActive = false
				p285._emoteEnded = true
			end
		else
			p285.danceActive = false
			p285._emoteEnded = true
		end
	else
		return
	end
end
function v_u_22.CleanupDance(p300) -- name: CleanupDance
	p300:StopMoving()
	p300:SetFaceOwner(false)
	p300.danceActive = false
	p300.danceElapsed = 0
	p300._emoteEnded = false
end
function v_u_22.StartConfused(p301) -- name: StartConfused
	if p301.companion.Animations.Confused then
		if p301:_OwnerFrontPosition() then
			p301:SetState("MoodAction")
			p301:EnterConfusedPhase("Approach")
		else
			p301._emoteEnded = true
		end
	else
		p301._emoteEnded = true
		return
	end
end
function v_u_22.EnterConfusedPhase(p_u_302, p303) -- name: EnterConfusedPhase
	p_u_302.emotePhaseGen = p_u_302.emotePhaseGen + 1
	local v_u_304 = p_u_302.emotePhaseGen
	if p303 == "Approach" then
		p_u_302:SetFaceOwner(false)
		p_u_302:MoveTo(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), {
			["speed"] = 9,
			["animation"] = nil,
			["arriveRadius"] = 2,
			["trackFn"] = nil,
			["onArrive"] = nil,
			["animation"] = p_u_302:GetWalkAnimation(),
			["trackFn"] = function() -- name: trackFn
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_302
				return p_u_302:_OwnerFrontPosition()
			end,
			["onArrive"] = function() -- name: onArrive
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_302, (copy) v_u_304
				local v305
				if p_u_302.activeMood == "Confused" then
					v305 = p_u_302.emotePhaseGen == v_u_304
				else
					v305 = false
				end
				if v305 then
					p_u_302:EnterConfusedPhase("React")
				end
			end
		})
		return
	elseif p303 == "React" then
		p_u_302:StopMoving()
		p_u_302:SetFaceOwner(true)
		p_u_302:PlayAnimation("Confused")
		task.delay(3, function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_302, (copy) v_u_304
			local v306
			if p_u_302.activeMood == "Confused" then
				v306 = p_u_302.emotePhaseGen == v_u_304
			else
				v306 = false
			end
			if v306 then
				p_u_302:EnterConfusedPhase("Retreat")
			end
		end)
	elseif p303 == "Retreat" then
		p_u_302:SetFaceOwner(false)
		local v307 = p_u_302.companion.Owner.Character
		if v307 then
			v307 = v307:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		end
		if not v307 then
			p_u_302._emoteEnded = true
			return
		end
		local v308 = v307.CFrame.RightVector * (math.random() > 0.5 and 1 or -1)
		p_u_302:MoveTo(p_u_302.companion.RootPart.Position + v308 * 6, {
			["speed"] = 7,
			["animation"] = nil,
			["arriveRadius"] = 1.5,
			["onArrive"] = nil,
			["animation"] = p_u_302:GetWalkAnimation(),
			["onArrive"] = function() -- name: onArrive
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_302, (copy) v_u_304
				local v309
				if p_u_302.activeMood == "Confused" then
					v309 = p_u_302.emotePhaseGen == v_u_304
				else
					v309 = false
				end
				if v309 then
					p_u_302._emoteEnded = true
				end
			end
		})
	end
end
function v_u_22.CleanupConfused(p310) -- name: CleanupConfused
	p310.emotePhaseGen = p310.emotePhaseGen + 1
	p310:StopMoving()
	p310:SetFaceOwner(false)
	p310._emoteEnded = false
end
function v_u_22.StartWander(p311, p312) -- name: StartWander
	p311:SetState("MoodAction")
	p311.wanderSpots = p312.WanderSpots or {}
	p311.wanderSpotIndex = 0
	if #p311.wanderSpots == 0 then
		p311._wanderEnded = true
	else
		p311:EnterWanderPhase("WalkToNextSpot")
	end
end
function v_u_22.EnterWanderPhase(p_u_313, p314) -- name: EnterWanderPhase
	p_u_313.wanderPhaseGen = p_u_313.wanderPhaseGen + 1
	local v_u_315 = p_u_313.wanderPhaseGen
	if p314 == "WalkToNextSpot" then
		p_u_313.wanderSpotIndex = p_u_313.wanderSpotIndex + 1
		if p_u_313.wanderSpotIndex > #p_u_313.wanderSpots then
			p_u_313._wanderEnded = true
		else
			p_u_313:MoveTo(p_u_313.wanderSpots[p_u_313.wanderSpotIndex], {
				["speed"] = 6,
				["animation"] = nil,
				["arriveRadius"] = 1.5,
				["onArrive"] = nil,
				["animation"] = p_u_313:GetWalkAnimation(),
				["onArrive"] = function() -- name: onArrive
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_313, (copy) v_u_315
					local v316
					if p_u_313.activeMood == "Wander" then
						v316 = p_u_313.wanderPhaseGen == v_u_315
					else
						v316 = false
					end
					if v316 then
						p_u_313:EnterWanderPhase("PauseAtSpot")
					end
				end
			})
		end
	else
		if p314 == "PauseAtSpot" then
			p_u_313:StopMoving()
			p_u_313:_PlayIfPresent("SitIdle", "Idle")
			local v317 = 0.5 + math.random() * 1.3
			task.delay(v317, function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_313, (copy) v_u_315
				local v318
				if p_u_313.activeMood == "Wander" then
					v318 = p_u_313.wanderPhaseGen == v_u_315
				else
					v318 = false
				end
				if v318 then
					p_u_313:EnterWanderPhase("WalkToNextSpot")
				end
			end)
		end
		return
	end
end
function v_u_22.CleanupWander(p319) -- name: CleanupWander
	p319:StopMoving()
	p319.wanderSpots = {}
	p319.wanderSpotIndex = 0
	p319._wanderEnded = false
end
function v_u_22.StartDive(p320, p321) -- name: StartDive
	local v322 = p320.companion.RootPart.Position
	local v323 = p320:_FindWaterVolume(p321.WaterTarget or v322)
	if v323 then
		p320:SetState("MoodAction")
		p320.diveOrigin = v322
		p320.diveReturnPos = v322
		p320.diveVolume = v323
		p320.diveWaterTarget = v323.Point
		p320.diveSubmerged = p320:_IsSubmerged(v323)
		if p320.diveSubmerged then
			local v324 = p320:_ClampToZone(v323, v322)
			p320.diveEntryPoint = v324
			p320.diveWaterTarget = v324
		else
			local v325 = p320:_DiveEntryPoint()
			p320.diveEntryPoint = v325
			local v326 = v325.X
			local v327 = v323.Point.Y
			local v328 = v325.Z
			p320.diveWaterTarget = Vector3.new(v326, v327, v328)
		end
		p320.divePayload = p321.Payload
		p320.diveFishUid = p321.FishUID
		p320.diveFishName = p321.FishName
		p320.diveItemName = p321.ItemName
		p320.diveGrabAt = p321.GrabAt or workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + 5
		p320.diveGrabDuration = p321.GrabDuration
		p320.diveHitbox = nil
		p320.diveTargetLostSince = nil
		p320.diveHoldCFrame = nil
		p320.diveHoldingItem = false
		p320.diveHoverPhase = 0
		p320.diveSearching = false
		p320.diveGrabbed = false
		p320.companion.MoodIgnoreGroundClamp = true
		p320.companion.MoodUninterruptible = true
		p320.companion.AllowWater = true
		p320:EnterDivePhase("ArcIn")
	else
		p320._diveEnded = true
	end
end
function v_u_22.EnterDivePhase(p_u_329, p330) -- name: EnterDivePhase
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_8
	p_u_329.divePhaseGen = p_u_329.divePhaseGen + 1
	local v_u_331 = p_u_329.divePhaseGen
	if p330 == "ArcIn" then
		p_u_329.diveSearching = false
		p_u_329.diveHoldCFrame = nil
		if p_u_329.diveSubmerged then
			if p_u_329.divePayload == "Fish" or p_u_329.divePayload == "Refine" then
				p_u_329:EnterDivePhase("Chase")
			else
				p_u_329:EnterDivePhase("Search")
			end
		else
			p_u_329:StartArc(p_u_329.diveEntryPoint, function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_329, (copy) v_u_331
				local v332
				if p_u_329.activeMood == "Dive" then
					v332 = p_u_329.divePhaseGen == v_u_331
				else
					v332 = false
				end
				if v332 then
					if p_u_329.divePayload == "Fish" or p_u_329.divePayload == "Refine" then
						p_u_329:EnterDivePhase("Chase")
					else
						p_u_329:EnterDivePhase("Search")
					end
				else
					return
				end
			end, nil, "Dive")
			return
		end
	elseif p330 == "Search" then
		p_u_329.diveSearching = true
		p_u_329.diveHoldCFrame = nil
		local v333 = 7 + math.random() * 7
		p_u_329:StartWaterSwim(p_u_329:_RollSearchPoint(), v333, function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_329, (copy) v_u_331
			local v334
			if p_u_329.activeMood == "Dive" then
				v334 = p_u_329.divePhaseGen == v_u_331
			else
				v334 = false
			end
			if v334 then
				p_u_329.diveHoldCFrame = p_u_329.companion.RootPart.CFrame
				local v335 = 0.5 + math.random() * 0.7
				task.delay(v335, function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_329, (ref) v_u_331
					local v336
					if p_u_329.activeMood == "Dive" then
						v336 = p_u_329.divePhaseGen == v_u_331
					else
						v336 = false
					end
					if v336 then
						p_u_329.diveHoldCFrame = nil
						p_u_329:EnterDivePhase("Search")
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
		return
	elseif p330 == "Chase" then
		p_u_329.diveSearching = false
		p_u_329.diveHoldCFrame = nil
		local v337 = p_u_329:_ResolveHitbox()
		if v337 then
			p_u_329:StartWaterSwim(v337.Position, 14, function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_329, (copy) v_u_331
				local v338
				if p_u_329.activeMood == "Dive" then
					v338 = p_u_329.divePhaseGen == v_u_331
				else
					v338 = false
				end
				if v338 then
					p_u_329:EnterDivePhase("Grab")
				end
			end, function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_329
				local v339 = p_u_329:_ResolveHitbox()
				if v339 then
					v339 = v339.Position
				end
				return v339
			end)
		else
			p_u_329:EnterDivePhase("SwimBack")
		end
	elseif p330 == "Grab" then
		p_u_329.diveGrabbed = true
		p_u_329.diveSearching = false
		p_u_329:StopArc()
		p_u_329:StopWaterSwim()
		p_u_329:StopMoving()
		p_u_329.diveHoldCFrame = p_u_329.companion.RootPart.CFrame
		p_u_329:PlaySound("Happy", true)
		local v340 = p_u_329:_ResolveHeldName()
		if v340 then
			p_u_329.diveHoldingItem = p_u_329:SpawnHeldItem(v340, p_u_329.divePayload == "Fish")
		end
		if p_u_329:_UseHoldAnimation() then
			p_u_329:PlayAnimation("HoldItem")
		else
			p_u_329:_PlayIfPresent("Wiggle", p_u_329:GetSwimAnimation())
		end
		local v341 = p_u_329.diveGrabDuration or 1.2
		task.delay(v341, function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_329, (copy) v_u_331, (ref) v_u_7
			local v342
			if p_u_329.activeMood == "Dive" then
				v342 = p_u_329.divePhaseGen == v_u_331
			else
				v342 = false

function v_u_70.UpdateMood(p91, p92) -- name: UpdateMood

function v_u_70.GetPathBend(p267, p268, p269) -- name: GetPathBend

	if v270.Magnitude < 0.5 then

	end
	local v271 = 0
	local v272 = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

		end

		if v277.Magnitude > 0.01 then
			v279 = v277.Unit
		else
			local v280 = -v270.Z

			v279 = Vector3.new(v280, 0, v281).Unit
		end

		v272 = v279 * math.min(v282, 8)

	end
	return v272
end

function v_u_70.GetSideStand(p290, p291) -- name: GetSideStand

		end

			continue
		end

function v_u_70.GetAvoidance(p307) -- name: GetAvoidance

	for _, v309 in ipairs(p307:GetObstacles(3, 3)) do
		local v310 = (p307.basePosition - v309.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
		local v311 = v310.Magnitude

		end
		local v312 = p307.basePosition.Y - v309.Position.Y
		if math.abs(v312) >= 3.5 then

		end
		v308 = v308 + v310.Unit * (v309.Radius - v311)
	end
	return v308
end
function v_u_70.UpdateRoamer(p313, p314, p315) -- name: UpdateRoamer
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_57, (copy) v_u_54, (copy) v_u_22, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_18
	local v316 = p313.catchData
	local v317, v318, v319, v320 = p313:GetBeat(p314)
	local v321 = v317.Finish - v317.Start
	p313.pose = p313:SamplePose(v317, v318)
	if v320 and not p313.roamerHitbox then
		p313.roamerHitbox = v_u_57(v316.FishUID)
	end
	if not p313.hookStart and (v317.Name ~= "Run" and v317.Name ~= "Shoot") then
		p313:HookRoamer()
	end
	if v317.Name == "Run" then
		if v320 then
			p313.path = p313:BuildPath(p313.catchStart, p313.standPosition)
		end
		local v322 = p313.path
		p313.basePosition = v_u_54(v322, v319)
		local v323 = p313.standPosition
		local v324 = p313:GetFishPosition()
		local v325 = p313.entryYaw
		local v326 = (v324 - v323) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
		if v326.Magnitude > 0.5 then
			local v327 = -v326.X
			local v328 = -v326.Z
			v325 = math.atan2(v327, v328)
		end
		p313:FacePath(v322, v318, v321, v325)
		p313:ApplyBody(p315)
		p313:PlayMoveAnimation()
		return
	elseif v317.Name == "Shoot" then
		if v320 then
			p313:CreateWeb()
		end
		local v329 = p313:GetFishPosition()
		p313.basePosition = p313.standPosition
		local v330 = p313.standPosition
		local v331 = p313.entryYaw
		local v332 = (v329 - v330) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
		if v332.Magnitude > 0.5 then
			local v333 = -v332.X
			local v334 = -v332.Z
			v331 = math.atan2(v333, v334)
		end
		p313:TurnToward(v318, v331)
		p313:ApplyBody(p315)
		p313:PlayBeatAnimation("Spit")
		local v335 = p313:GetMouthPosition()
		local v336 = 1 - (1 - v319) * (1 - v319)
		local v337 = v335:Lerp(v329, v336)
		local v338 = v336 * 4 * (1 - v336)
		local v339 = v337 + Vector3.new(0, v338, 0)
		p313:SetGlob(v339, 0.5)
		p313:SetWeb(v339, 0)
		return
	elseif v317.Name == "Hook" then
		local v340 = p313.hookStart
		p313:ReelFish(v340:Lerp(p313:GetSurfacePoint(v340) - Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0), 1 - (1 - v319) ^ 3), v318, p314, p315)
		return
	elseif v317.Name == "Reel" then
		local v341 = v321 / 0.7
		local v342 = math.round(v341)
		local v343 = math.max(v342, 1)
		local v344 = 6.283185307179586 * v343 * v319
		local v345 = (p313:GetSurfacePoint(p313.hookStart) - Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0)):Lerp(v316.EntryPoint - Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0), v319 - math.sin(v344) / (6.283185307179586 * v343))
		p313.pose = v_u_22(p313.pose, v_u_16, (1 - math.cos(v344)) / 2)
		p313:ReelFish(v345, v318, p314, p315)
		for v346 = 1, v343 do
			if not p313:Passed(v321 * (v346 - 0.5) / v343) then
				continue
			end
			p313:Cue(p313:GetSurfacePoint(v345), v_u_12, 3)
		end
		return
	elseif v317.Name == "Lift" then
		local v347 = v316.EntryPoint - Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0)
		if v320 then
			p313.flingStart = p313:GetReelCFrame(v347, p314)
			p313:Cue(v316.EntryPoint, v_u_11, 20)
		end
		p313.basePosition = p313.standPosition
		local v348 = p313.standPosition
		local v349 = p313.entryYaw
		local v350 = (v347 - v348) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
		if v350.Magnitude > 0.5 then
			local v351 = -v350.X
			local v352 = -v350.Z
			v349 = math.atan2(v351, v352)
		end
		p313:TurnToward(v318, v349)
		p313:ApplyBody(p315)
		p313:PlayBeatAnimation("Lifting")
		local v353 = p313:GetHoldCFrame()
		local v354 = CFrame.new
		local v355 = p313.flingStart.Position
		local v356 = v353.Position
		local v357 = 1 - (1 - v319) * (1 - v319)
		local v358 = v355:Lerp(v356, v357)
		local v359 = v357 * 12 * (1 - v357)
		local v360 = v354(v358 + Vector3.new(0, v359, 0)) * p313.flingStart.Rotation:Lerp(v353.Rotation, v319 * v319 * (3 - v319 * 2))
		p313:PlaceFish(v360)
		if v319 < 0.8 then
			p313:SetWeb(p313:GetFishMouthPosition(v360), 0)
		else
			p313:RemoveWeb()
		end
	elseif v317.Name == "Return" then
		if v320 then
			p313:RemoveWeb()
		end
		p313:WalkHome(p313.standPosition, v318, v321, v319, v320, p315)
		local v361 = p313:GetHoldCFrame()
		local v362 = CFrame.Angles
		local v363 = p314 * 20 + p313.catchSeed
		p313:PlaceFish(v361 * v362(0, math.sin(v363) * 0.35 * (1 - v319), 0))
	else
		if v320 then
			local v364 = p313:GetHoldCFrame()
			local v365 = v364.Position
			v_u_18.FilterDescendantsInstances = p313:GetGroundIgnore()
			local v366 = workspace:Raycast(v365 + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0), Vector3.new(0, -16, 0), v_u_18)
			local v367
			if v366 then
				v367 = v366.Position.Y
			else
				v367 = nil
			end
			local v368 = v367 or v364.Position.Y - 3
			p313.flingStart = v364
			local v369 = CFrame.new(v364.Position.X, v368 + p313.fishHalfSize.X, v364.Position.Z)
			local v370 = CFrame.Angles
			local v371 = p313.catchSeed % 360
			p313.landCFrame = v369 * v370(0, math.rad(v371), 1.5707963267948966)
		end
		local v372 = p313.path
		local v373
		if v372 then
			v373 = v_u_54(v372, 1)
		else
			v373 = p313.basePosition
		end
		p313.basePosition = v373
		p313.yaw = p313.entryYaw
		p313:ApplyBody(p315)
		p313:PlayBeatAnimation("Toss")
		local v374 = v318 / 0.25
		local v375 = math.clamp(v374, 0, 1)
		if v375 < 1 then
			local v376 = p313:GetLandCFrame()
			p313:PlaceFish(CFrame.new(p313.flingStart.Position:Lerp(v376.Position, v375 * v375)) * p313.flingStart.Rotation:Lerp(v376.Rotation, v375))
		else
			p313:PlaceFish(p313:GetFlopCFrame(v318 - 0.25))
		end
		local v377 = (v318 - v321 + 0.4) / 0.4
		local v378 = math.clamp(v377, 0, 1)
		p313:SetFishFade(v378 * v378 * (3 - v378 * 2))
	end
end
function v_u_70.HookRoamer(p379) -- name: HookRoamer
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11
	local v380 = p379:GetFishPosition()
	p379.hookStart = v380
	p379:SetGlob(nil)
	p379:HideRoamer()
	p379:RevealFish()
	p379:Cue(p379:GetSurfacePoint(v380), v_u_11, 20)
end
function v_u_70.ReelFish(p381, p382, p383, p384, p385) -- name: ReelFish
	p381:CreateWeb()
	p381.basePosition = p381.standPosition
	local v386 = p381.standPosition
	local v387 = p381.entryYaw
	local v388 = (p382 - v386) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
	if v388.Magnitude > 0.5 then
		local v389 = -v388.X
		local v390 = -v388.Z
		v387 = math.atan2(v389, v390)
	end
	p381:TurnToward(p383, v387)
	p381:ApplyBody(p385)
	p381:PlayBeatAnimation("Reeling")
	local v391 = p381:GetReelCFrame(p382, p384)
	p381:PlaceFish(v391)
	p381:SetWeb(p381:GetFishMouthPosition(v391), 0)
end
function v_u_70.GetReelCFrame(p392, p393, p394) -- name: GetReelCFrame
	local v395 = (p392.standPosition - p393) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
	local v396 = v395.Magnitude <= 0.5 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) or v395.Unit
	local v397 = CFrame.lookAlong(p393, v396)
	local v398 = CFrame.Angles
	local v399 = p394 * 20 + p392.catchSeed
	return v397 * v398(0, math.sin(v399) * 0.35, 0)
end
function v_u_70.GetSurfacePoint(p400, p401) -- name: GetSurfacePoint
	local v402 = p401.X
	local v403 = p400.catchData.EntryPoint.Y
	local v404 = p401.Z
	return Vector3.new(v402, v403, v404)
end
function v_u_70.UpdateBite(p405, p406, p407) -- name: UpdateBite
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11
	local v408 = p405.catchData
	local v409, v410, v411, v412 = p405:GetBeat(p406)
	local v413 = v408.Bobber
	if v413 and v413.Parent then
		p405.biteTarget = v413.WorldPosition + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)
	elseif v412 and v409.Index == 1 then
		p405.biteTarget = p405.catchStart
	end
	local v414 = p405.biteTarget
	p405.pose = p405:SamplePose(v409, v410)
	if v412 and v409.Index == 1 then
		p405.biteLeap = p405:CrossesOwner(p405.catchStart, v414)
	end
	local v415 = p405.biteLeap and 9.333333333333334 or 0
	if v409.Name == "Shoot" then
		if v412 then
			p405:CreateWeb()
		end
		p405.basePosition = p405.catchStart
		local v416 = p405.catchStart
		local v417 = p405.entryYaw
		local v418 = (v414 - v416) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
		if v418.Magnitude > 0.5 then
			local v419 = -v418.X
			local v420 = -v418.Z
			v417 = math.atan2(v419, v420)
		end
		p405:TurnToward(v410, v417)
		p405:ApplyBody(p407)
		p405:PlayBeatAnimation("Spit")
		local v421 = p405:GetMouthPosition()
		local v422 = p405.biteLeap and 7 or 1
		local v423 = 1 - (1 - v411) * (1 - v411)
		local v424 = v421:Lerp(v414, v423)
		local v425 = v422 * 4 * v423 * (1 - v423)
		local v426 = v424 + Vector3.new(0, v425, 0)
		p405:SetGlob(v426, 0.5)
		p405:SetWeb(v426, -v415 * (1 - (1 - v411) * (1 - v411)))
		return
	elseif v409.Name == "Zip" then
		local v427 = p405.catchStart
		local v428 = p405.biteLeap and 7 or 2
		local v429 = 3.141592653589793 * v411
		local v430 = (1 - math.cos(v429)) / 2
		local v431 = v427:Lerp(v414, v430)
		local v432 = v428 * 4 * v430 * (1 - v430)
		p405.basePosition = v431 + Vector3.new(0, v432, 0)
		local v433 = p405.catchStart
		local v434 = p405.yaw
		local v435 = (v414 - v433) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
		if v435.Magnitude > 0.5 then
			local v436 = -v435.X
			local v437 = -v435.Z
			v434 = math.atan2(v436, v437)
		end
		p405.yaw = v434
		p405:ApplyBody(p407)
		p405:PlayBeatAnimation("Run", 2.2)
		p405:SetGlob(v414, 0.5)
		local v438 = -v415
		local v439 = 3.141592653589793 * v411
		p405:SetWeb(v414, v438 * (1 - (1 - math.cos(v439)) / 2))
		return
	elseif v409.Name == "Sting" then
		if v412 then
			p405:SetGlob(nil)
			p405:RemoveWeb()
			p405:Cue(v414, v_u_11, 20)
			p405:Cue(v414, v_u_11, 30, Color3.fromRGB(200, 30, 40))
		end
		p405.basePosition = v414
		local v440 = CFrame.Angles
		local v441 = 3.141592653589793 * v411
		p405:ApplyBody(p407, v440(math.sin(v441) * -0.35, 0, 0))
		p405:PlayBeatAnimation("SitIdle")
	else
		if v412 then
			local v442 = p405:GetOwnerRoot()
			local v443
			if v442 then
				v443 = v442.CFrame.Rotation
			else
				v443 = nil
			end
			p405.returnRotation = v443
			p405.biteFrom = p405.basePosition
		end
		local v444 = p405:GetReturnPosition()
		local v445 = p405.biteFrom
		local v446 = p405.biteLeap and 7 or 3
		local v447 = v411 * v411 * (3 - v411 * 2)
		local v448 = v445:Lerp(v444, v447)
		local v449 = v446 * 4 * v447 * (1 - v447)
		p405.basePosition = v448 + Vector3.new(0, v449, 0)
		local v450 = p405.biteFrom
		local v451 = p405.yaw
		local v452 = (v444 - v450) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
		if v452.Magnitude > 0.5 then
			local v453 = -v452.X
			local v454 = -v452.Z
			v451 = math.atan2(v453, v454)
		end
		p405.yaw = v451
		p405:ApplyBody(p407)
		p405:PlayBeatAnimation("Run", 2.2)
	end
end
function v_u_70.Cue(p455, p456, p457, p458, p459) -- name: Cue
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_69
	if not p455.visualsHidden then
		v_u_69(p456, p457, p458, p459)
	end
end
function v_u_70.UpdateWeb(p460, p461, p462) -- name: UpdateWeb
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_54, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_12
	local v463 = p460.catchData.CastPoint
	local v464, v465, v466, v467 = p460:GetBeat(p461)
	local v468 = v464.Finish - v464.Start
	local v469 = p460.standPosition
	local v470 = p460.entryYaw
	local v471 = (v463 - v469) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
	if v471.Magnitude > 0.5 then
		local v472 = -v471.X
		local v473 = -v471.Z
		v470 = math.atan2(v472, v473)
	end
	p460.pose = p460:SamplePose(v464, v465)
	if v464.Name == "Run" then
		if v467 then
			p460.path = p460:BuildPath(p460.catchStart, p460.standPosition)
		end
		local v474 = p460.path
		p460.basePosition = v_u_54(v474, v466)
		p460:FacePath(v474, v465, v468, v470)
		p460:ApplyBody(p462)
		p460:PlayMoveAnimation()
		return
	elseif v464.Name == "Cast" then
		p460.basePosition = p460.standPosition
		p460:TurnToward(v465, v470)
		p460:ApplyBody(p462)
		p460:PlayBeatAnimation("Spit")
		if v467 then
			p460:CreateWeb()
		end
		local v475 = p460:GetMouthPosition()
		local v476 = 1 - (1 - v466) * (1 - v466)
		local v477 = v475:Lerp(v463, v476)
		local v478 = v476 * 12 * (1 - v476)
		local v479 = v477 + Vector3.new(0, v478, 0)
		p460:SetGlob(v479, ((1 - (1 - v466) * (1 - v466)) * 0.75 + 0.25) * 0.6)
		p460:SetWeb(v479, 0)
		return
	elseif v464.Name == "Bite" then
		if v467 then
			p460:CreateWeb()
			p460:Cue(v463, v_u_11, 20)
		end
		if p460:Passed(0.7) or p460:Passed(1.15) then
			p460:Cue(v463, v_u_12, 3)
		end
		if p460:Passed(v468 - 0.35) then
			p460:Cue(v463, v_u_12, 6)
		end
		local v480 = v468 - v465
		local v481 = v465 * 6
		local v482 = math.sin(v481) * 0.15
		local v483 = -((v465 - 0.7) / 0.06) ^ 2
		local v484 = math.exp(v483)
		local v485 = -((v465 - 1.15) / 0.06) ^ 2
		local v486 = (v484 + math.exp(v485)) * 0.2
		local v487
		if v480 < 0.35 then
			local v488 = 1 - v480 / 0.35
			v487 = v488 * v488 * (3 - v488 * 2) * 0.8
		else
			v487 = 0
		end
		local v489 = v482 - v486 - v487
		local v490 = v463 + Vector3.new(0, v489, 0)
		p460.basePosition = p460.standPosition
		p460:TurnToward(v465, v470)
		p460:ApplyBody(p462)
		p460:PlayBeatAnimation("SitIdle")
		p460:SetGlob(v490, 0.6)
		local v491 = v465 / 0.2
		local v492 = math.clamp(v491, 0, 1)
		p460:SetWeb(v490, v492 * v492 * (3 - v492 * 2) * 1.5)
		return
	elseif v464.Name == "Hook" then
		if v467 then
			p460:CreateWeb()
			p460:SetGlob(nil)
			p460:RevealFish()
			p460:Cue(v463, v_u_11, 40)
		end
		p460.basePosition = p460.standPosition
		p460:TurnToward(v465, v470)
		p460:ApplyBody(p462)
		p460:PlayBeatAnimation("Reeling")
		local v493 = p460:GetHookCFrame(v463, v466, p461)
		p460:PlaceFish(v493)
		p460:SetWeb(p460:GetFishMouthPosition(v493), 0)
		return
	elseif v464.Name == "Fling" then
		if v467 then
			p460:SetGlob(nil)
			p460.flingStart = p460:GetHookCFrame(v463, 1, p461)
			p460.landCFrame = p460:ComputeLandingCFrame()
		end
		p460.basePosition = p460.standPosition
		p460:TurnToward(v465, v470)
		p460:ApplyBody(p462)
		p460:PlayBeatAnimation("Toss")
		local v494 = p460:GetFlingCFrame(v466)
		p460:PlaceFish(v494)
		if v466 < 0.3 then
			p460:SetWeb(p460:GetFishMouthPosition(v494), 0)
		else
			p460:RemoveWeb()
		end
	else
		p460:UpdateWalkBack(p460.standPosition, v465, v468, v466, v467, p462)
		return
	end
end
function v_u_70.SetGlob(p495, p496, p497) -- name: SetGlob
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10
	if p496 and not p495.visualsHidden then
		if not p495.glob then
			local v498 = Instance.new("Part")
			v498.Name = "WebweaverGlob"
			v498.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
			v498.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			v498.Color = v_u_10
			v498.Anchored = true
			v498.CanCollide = false
			v498.CanQuery = false
			v498.CanTouch = false
			v498.CastShadow = false
			p495.glob = v498
			p495.catchTrove:Add(v498)
		end
		local v499 = p495.glob
		v499.Size = Vector3.new(0.8, 0.8, 0.8) * (p497 or 1)
		v499.Position = p496
		local v500 = workspace:FindFirstChild("active")
		if v500 then
			v500 = v500:FindFirstChild("debrisfx")
		end
		v499.Parent = v500 or workspace
	elseif p495.glob then
		p495.glob.Parent = nil
	end
end
function v_u_70.GetHookCFrame(p501, p502, p503, p504) -- name: GetHookCFrame
	local v505 = p501.fishHalfSize.Z
	local v506 = 1 + v505
	local v507 = p502 - Vector3.new(0, v506, 0)
	local v508 = 2.5 + v505
	local v509 = v507:Lerp(p502 + Vector3.new(0, v508, 0), 1 - (1 - p503) ^ 3)
	local v510 = p504 * 20 + p501.catchSeed
	local v511 = math.sin(v510) * 0.35 * (1 - p503)
	return CFrame.fromMatrix(v509, Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)) * CFrame.Angles(0, v511, 0)
end
function v_u_70.ComputeLandingCFrame(p512) -- name: ComputeLandingCFrame
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_18
	local v513 = p512:GetOwnerRoot()
	local v514
	if v513 then
		v514 = v513.CFrame
	else
		v514 = CFrame.new(p512.basePosition)
	end
	local v515 = (p512.catchIndex - 3) * 1.2
	local v516 = v514:PointToWorldSpace((Vector3.new(v515, 0, -3.5)))
	v_u_18.FilterDescendantsInstances = p512:GetGroundIgnore()
	local v517 = workspace:Raycast(v516 + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0), Vector3.new(0, -16, 0), v_u_18)
	local v518
	if v517 then
		v518 = v517.Position.Y
	else
		v518 = nil
	end
	local v519 = v518 or v516.Y - 3
	local v520 = CFrame.new(v516.X, v519 + p512.fishHalfSize.X, v516.Z)
	local v521 = CFrame.Angles
	local v522 = p512.catchSeed % 360
	return v520 * v521(0, math.rad(v522), 1.5707963267948966)
end
function v_u_70.GetLandCFrame(p523) -- name: GetLandCFrame
	if not p523.landCFrame then
		p523.landCFrame = p523:ComputeLandingCFrame()
	end
	return p523.landCFrame
end
function v_u_70.GetFlingCFrame(p524, p525) -- name: GetFlingCFrame
	local v526 = p524:GetLandCFrame()
	local v527 = p524.flingStart.Position:Lerp(v526.Position, p525)
	local v528 = p525 * 24 * (1 - p525)
	local v529 = v527 + Vector3.new(0, v528, 0)
	return CFrame.new(v529) * p524.flingStart.Rotation:Lerp(v526.Rotation, p525 * p525 * (3 - p525 * 2)) * CFrame.Angles(6.283185307179586 * p525, 0, 0)
end
function v_u_70.GetFlopCFrame(p530, p531) -- name: GetFlopCFrame
	local v532 = -p531 * 1.5
	local v533 = math.exp(v532)
	local v534 = p531 * 14
	local v535 = p530:GetLandCFrame()
	local v536 = math.sin(v534)
	local v537 = math.abs(v536) * 0.6 * v533
	return (v535 + Vector3.new(0, v537, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.sin(v534) * 0.5 * v533)
end
function v_u_70.UpdateCocoon(p538, p539, p540) -- name: UpdateCocoon
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_10
	local v541, v542, v543, v544 = p538:GetBeat(p539)
	local v545 = v541.Finish - v541.Start
	p538.pose = p538:SamplePose(v541, v542)
	if v541.Name == "Weave" then
		if v544 then
			p538:CreateShell(p538:GetEggShellSize())
			p538:CreateWeb()
		end
		local v546 = p538.orbitStartAngle
		local v547 = 3.141592653589793 * v543
		local v548 = v546 + (1 - math.cos(v547)) / 2 * 2 * 3.141592653589793 * 2
		p538.basePosition = p538:GetOrbitPosition(v543)
		local v549 = -math.sin(v548)
		local v550 = math.cos(v548)
		local v551 = Vector3.new(v549, 0, v550)
		local v552 = -v551.X
		local v553 = -v551.Z
		p538:TurnToward(v542, (math.atan2(v552, v553)))
		p538:ApplyBody(p540)
		p538:PlayMoveAnimation()
		local v554 = p538:GetEggCFrame()
		local v555 = (v543 - 1) ^ 3 * 2.70158 + 1 + (v543 - 1) ^ 2 * 1.70158
		p538:SetShell(v554, (math.max(v555, 0.05)))
		p538:SetWeb(v554.Position, 0)
		return
	elseif v541.Name == "Burst" then
		if v544 then
			p538:RemoveWeb()
			p538:RevealFish()
			p538:Cue(p538:GetEggCFrame().Position, v_u_11, 30, v_u_10)
		end
		p538.basePosition = p538:GetOrbitPosition(1)
		local v556 = p538.basePosition
		local v557 = p538.cocoonSpot
		local v558 = p538.entryYaw
		local v559 = (v557 - v556) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
		if v559.Magnitude > 0.5 then
			local v560 = -v559.X
			local v561 = -v559.Z
			v558 = math.atan2(v560, v561)
		end
		p538:TurnToward(v542, v558)
		p538:ApplyBody(p540)
		p538:PlayBeatAnimation("SitIdle")
		if v542 < 0.08 then
			p538:SetShell(p538:GetEggCFrame(), 1 + 0.2 * v542 / 0.08)
		else
			p538:RemoveShell()
		end
		p538:PlaceFish(p538:GetBurstCFrame(v543, p539))
		return
	elseif v541.Name == "Fling" then
		if v544 then
			p538:RemoveShell()
			p538.flingStart = p538:GetBurstCFrame(1, p539)
			p538.landCFrame = p538:ComputeLandingCFrame()
		end
		p538.basePosition = p538:GetOrbitPosition(1)
		p538.yaw = p538.entryYaw
		p538:ApplyBody(p540)
		p538:PlayBeatAnimation("Toss")
		p538:PlaceFish(p538:GetFlingCFrame(v543))
	else
		p538:UpdateWalkBack(p538:GetOrbitPosition(1), v542, v545, v543, v544, p540)
	end
end
function v_u_70.GetBurstCFrame(p562, p563, p564) -- name: GetBurstCFrame
	local v565 = p564 * 20 + p562.catchSeed
	local v566 = math.sin(v565) * 0.35 * (1 - p563)
	return p562:GetEggCFrame() * CFrame.new(0, 0, (1 - (1 - p563) ^ 3) * -3) * CFrame.Angles(0, v566, 0)

		if v583 then

function v_u_70.UpdateIdleWeb(p696, p697) -- name: UpdateIdleWeb
	local v698 = p696:CanHoldIdleWeb()
	p696.idleTime = not v698 and 0 or p696.idleTime + p697
	if #p696.idleStrands == 0 then
		if p696.idleTime < 3 then
			return
		end
		p696:SpinIdleWeb()
	elseif not (v698 or p696.idleWebShrivel) then
		p696.idleWebShrivel = 0
	end
	local v699 = 0
	local v700 = p696.idleWebShrivel
	if v700 then
		p696.idleWebShrivel = v700 + p697
		local v701 = (v700 + p697) / 0.5
		v699 = math.clamp(v701, 0, 1)
	elseif p696.idleWebClock > p696.idleWebEnd then
		return
	end
	if v699 >= 1 then
		p696:ClearIdleWeb()
	else
		p696.idleWebClock = p696.idleWebClock + p697
		for _, v702 in ipairs(p696.idleStrands) do
			local v703 = (p696.idleWebClock - v702.Start) / v702.Duration
			local v704 = math.clamp(v703, 0, 1)
			local v705 = (1 - (1 - v704) * (1 - v704)) * (1 - v699)
			local v706 = v702.Beam
			v702.Tip.WorldCFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(v702.From:Lerp(v702.To, v705), v702.TipAxis, Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
			v706.CurveSize0 = v702.Bow * v705
			v706.CurveSize1 = -v702.Bow * v705
			v706.Width0 = v702.Width * (1 - v699)
			v706.Width1 = v702.Width * (1 - v699)
			v706.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(v699)
		end
	end
end
function v_u_70.SpinIdleWeb(p707) -- name: SpinIdleWeb
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_18
	local v708 = p707:GetOwnerRoot()
	if not v708 then
		return
	end
	local v709 = p707:GetGroundIgnore()
	local v710 = v708.Position
	v_u_18.FilterDescendantsInstances = v709
	local v711 = workspace:Raycast(v710 + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0), Vector3.new(0, -16, 0), v_u_18)
	local v712
	if v711 and (v711.Material ~= Enum.Material.Water and not v711.Instance:HasTag("PartWater")) then
		v712 = v711.Position.Y
	else
		v712 = nil
	end
	if not v712 then
		p707.idleTime = 0
		return
	end
	local v713 = v708.Position.X
	local v714 = v708.Position.Z
	local v715 = Vector3.new(v713, v712, v714)
	local v716 = v715 + Vector3.new(0, 0.15, 0)
	local v717 = Random.new()
	local v718 = v717:NextNumber(0, 6.283185307179586)
	local v719 = {}
	local v720 = 0
	for v721 = 1, 8 do
		local v722 = v718 + (v721 - 1) * 3.141592653589793 * 2 / 8 + v717:NextNumber(-0.10471975511965978, 0.10471975511965978)
		local v723 = math.cos(v722)
		local v724 = math.sin(v722)
		local v725 = Vector3.new(v723, 0, v724)
		local v726 = workspace:Raycast(v715 + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), v725 * 8, v_u_18)
		local v727 = (not v726 and 8 or v726.Distance - 0.3) / 0.5
		local v728 = v712
		local v729 = 0
		for v730 = 1, math.floor(v727) do
			local v731 = v715 + v725 * v730 * 0.5
			v_u_18.FilterDescendantsInstances = v709
			local v732 = workspace:Raycast(v731 + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0), Vector3.new(0, -16, 0), v_u_18)
			local v733
			if v732 and (v732.Material ~= Enum.Material.Water and not v732.Instance:HasTag("PartWater")) then
				v733 = v732.Position.Y
			else
				v733 = nil
			end
			if not v733 or v712 - v733 > 0.6 then
				break
			end
			v729 = v730 * 0.5
			if v733 - v712 > 0.6 then
				continue
			end
			v712 = v733
		end
		if v729 >= 1.5 then
			local v734 = v715 + v725 * v729
			local v735 = v734.X
			local v736 = v712 + 0.15
			local v737 = v734.Z
			v719[v721] = Vector3.new(v735, v736, v737)
			v720 = v720 + 1
			v712 = v728
		else
			v712 = v728
		end
	end
	if v720 < 4 then
		p707.idleTime = 0
	else
		p707.idleWebCenter = v716
		for v738, v739 in pairs(v719) do
			p707:AddWebStrand(v716, v739, 0, 0.07, (v738 - 1) * 0.05, 0.4)
		end
		local v740 = 0.75
		for _, v741 in ipairs({ 0.4, 0.7, 1 }) do
			local v742 = {}
			for v743, v744 in pairs(v719) do
				local v745 = v741 * v717:NextNumber(0.95, 1.05)
				v742[v743] = v716:Lerp(v744, (math.min(v745, 1)))
			end
			for v746 = 1, 8 do

	end
end

function v_u_58.Purchase(_, p404, p405) -- name: Purchase

			v_u_310(v409)

end

local function v_u_188(p179, p180, p181, p182) -- name: landPoint
	local v183 = (p180 - p179) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
	local v184 = v183.Magnitude <= 1 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v183.Unit
	for v185 = 0, p181, 2 do
		local v186 = p179 + v184 * v185
		local v187 = workspace:Raycast(v186 + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), Vector3.new(0, -40, 0), p182)
		if not v187 or v187.Material == Enum.Material.Water then
			continue
		end
		return v187.Position
	end
	return nil
end
local function v_u_203(p189, p190, p191) -- name: directRoute
	local v192 = (p190 - p189) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
	local v193 = v192.Magnitude
	if v193 > 120 then
		return nil
	end
	local v194 = v193 / 3
	local v195 = math.ceil(v194)
	local v196 = math.max(v195, 1)
	local v197 = p189
	local v198 = {}
	for v199 = 1, v196 do
		local v200 = p189 + v192 * (v199 / v196)
		local v201 = workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(v200.X, v197.Y + 2.5 + 1, v200.Z), Vector3.new(2, 0.5, 2), Vector3.new(0, -40, 0), p191)
		if not v201 or (v201.Position.Y - v197.Y > 2.5 or v201.Material == Enum.Material.Water) then
			return nil
		end
		if workspace:Raycast(v197 + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0), v201.Position - v197, p191) then
			return nil
		end
		local v202 = v201.Position
		table.insert(v198, v202)
		v197 = v201.Position
	end
	return v198
end
