local function v_u_103(p97, p98) -- name: sentenceJoin
	local v99 = p98 or "and"
	if typeof(p97) == "string" then
		return p97
	end
	local v100 = ""
	for v101, v102 in p97 do
		if v101 > 1 then
			if #p97 == 2 then
				v100 = v100 .. (" %* "):format(v99)
			elseif v101 == #p97 then
				v100 = v100 .. (", %* "):format(v99)
			else
				v100 = v100 .. ", "
			end
		end
		v100 = v100 .. v102
	end
	return v100
end
local function v_u_124(p104, p105) -- name: eventFlagsDesc
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_24
	if typeof(p104) ~= "table" or #p104 == 0 then
		return ""
	end
	if #p104 == 1 then
		local v106 = v_u_24[p104[1]]
		if v106 then
			return (" %* %*"):format(v106.Prefix, v106.DisplayName)
		end
		warn((("[QuestController] Unknown EventFlag \"%*,\" please add it to the \"eventFlags\" library!"):format(p104[1])))
		return (" during %*"):format(v106[1])
	end
	local v107 = {}
	local v108 = {}
	local v109 = p105 and ", and " or ", or "
	local v110 = p105 and "and " or "or "
	local v111 = p105 and " and " or " or "
	for _, v115 in p104 do
		local v113 = v_u_24[v115]
		local v114 = "during"
		if v113 then
			v114 = v113.Prefix
			local v115 = v113.DisplayName
		else
			warn((("[QuestController] Unknown EventFlag \"%*,\" please add it to the \"eventFlags\" library!"):format(p104[1])))
		end
		if v107[v114] then
			local v116 = v107[v114]
			table.insert(v116, v115)
		else
			v107[v114] = { v115 }
			table.insert(v108, v114)
		end
	end
	local v117 = table.create((#p104 + #v108) * 2 + 1)
	v117[1] = " "
	for v118, v119 in v108 do
		local v120 = v118 == #v108
		if v118 == 1 or #p104 <= 2 then
			if v120 and (#p104 == 2 and #v107[v119] == 1) then
				table.insert(v117, v111)
			end
		else
			table.insert(v117, ", ")
			if v120 and #v107[v119] == 1 then
				table.insert(v117, v110)
			end
		end
		table.insert(v117, v119)
		table.insert(v117, " ")
		for v121, v122 in v107[v119] do
			if v121 ~= 1 then
				local v123
				if v120 then
					v123 = v121 == #v107[v119]
				else
					v123 = v120
				end
				if #p104 > 2 then
					if v123 then
						table.insert(v117, v109)
					else
						table.insert(v117, ", ")
					end
				elseif v123 then
					table.insert(v117, v111)
				end
			end
			table.insert(v117, v122)
		end
	end
	return table.concat(v117)
end

function v_u_52.GetGoalDescription(_, p172, p173, p174, p175) -- name: GetGoalDescription
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_48, (copy) v_u_103, (copy) v_u_37, (copy) v_u_139, (copy) v_u_162, (copy) v_u_171, (copy) v_u_124, (copy) v_u_47, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_43, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_52, (copy) v_u_31, (copy) v_u_15

	if not v176 then
		warn((("Failed to find quest data for %*"):format(p172.Name)))
		return "???", false, {}
	end
	local v177
	if typeof(p174) == "table" then
		v177 = p174
	else
		local v178 = v176.List
		local v179
		if p174 then
			v179 = p174
		else
			local v180 = p173.Name
			v179 = tonumber(v180)
		end
		v177 = v178[v179]
	end
	if not v177 then
		warn((("Failed to find requirement data for %* - %*"):format(p172.Name, p174 or p173.Name)))
		return "???", false, {}
	end
	local v181 = ""
	local v182 = false
	local v183 = {}
	local v184
	if v177[1] == "SellFish" then
		local v185 = p173.Value
		local v186 = v177[2]
		local _ = v186 > 1
		local v187
		if v177[4] and (v177[4].Mutation or (v177[4].Shiny or v177[4].Sparkling)) then
			local v188 = {}
			local v189 = #v188 + 1
			local v190
			if v177[4].Mutation then
				v190 = v177[4].Mutation or nil
			else
				v190 = nil
			end
			v188[v189] = v190
			v188[#v188 + 1] = v177[4].Shiny and "Shiny" or nil
			v188[#v188 + 1] = v177[4].Sparkling and "Sparkling" or nil
			v187 = (" (Mutation: %*)"):format((table.concat(v188, ", ")))
		else
			v187 = ""
		end
		v181 = v181 .. ("Sell %* %*%* (%*/%*)"):format(v186, not v177[3] and "fish" or v_u_103(v177[3], "or"), v187, v185, v186)
		v182 = v186 <= v185
		v326 = ""
		if v176.CustomSufix then
			v184 = p172:FindFirstChild("CustomSufix")
			if v184 then
				v326 = " " .. v184.Value
			end
		end
		return v181 .. v326, v182, v183
	end
	if v177[1] == "AppraiseFish" then
		local v191 = p173.Value
		local v192 = v177[2]
		local v193 = math.floor(v191)

function v_u_23.Update(p38, _) -- name: Update
	local v39 = p38._trueProgressModifier
	local v40 = p38.trueprogressefficiency
	v39.Value = math.max(v40, 0)
	for v41, v42 in p38._active_modifiers do
		local v43 = 0
		local v44
		if v42.force_final == nil then
			v44 = false
		else
			v44 = #v42.force_final > 0
		end
		if not v44 then
			local v45
			if v42.force == nil then
				v45 = false
			else
				v45 = #v42.force > 0
			end
			if not v45 then
				if v42.add then
					for _, v47 in v42.add do
						if typeof(v47) == "Instance" then
							local v47 = v47.Value
						end
						v43 = v43 + v47
					end
				end
				if v42.multiply then
					for _, v49 in v42.multiply do
						if typeof(v49) == "Instance" then
							local v49 = v49.Value
						end
						v43 = v43 * v49
					end
				end
			end
			if v42.force then
				for _, v50 in v42.force do
					if typeof(v50) == "Instance" then
						v43 = v50.Value
					else
						v43 = v50
					end
				end
			end
			if v42.force_add then
				for _, v52 in v42.force_add do
					if typeof(v52) == "Instance" then
						local v52 = v52.Value
					end
					v43 = v43 + v52
				end
			end
			if v42.force_multiply then
				for _, v54 in v42.force_multiply do
					if typeof(v54) == "Instance" then
						local v54 = v54.Value
					end
					v43 = v43 * v54
				end
			end
		end
		if v42.force_final then
			for _, v55 in v42.force_final do
				if typeof(v55) == "Instance" then
					v43 = v55.Value
				else
					v43 = v55
				end
			end
		end
		p38[v41] = v43
	end
	local v56 = p38.barSize
	local v57 = p38.minBarSize
	p38.barSize = math.max(v56, v57)
	if p38.barSize >= 1 then
		p38.barPosition = 0.5
	else
		local v58 = p38.barPosition
		local v59 = p38.minBarPosition + p38.barSize / 2
		local v60 = p38.maxBarPosition - p38.barSize / 2
		p38.barPosition = math.clamp(v58, v59, v60)
	end
end

	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3

	p61.reel_progress.bar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(v66, 0, 1), 1)

function v_u_23.AddModifier(p72, p73, p74, p_u_75) -- name: AddModifier
	if p72._active_modifiers[p73] then
		if not p72._active_modifiers[p73][p74] then
			p72._active_modifiers[p73][p74] = {}
		end
	else
		p72._active_modifiers[p73] = {
			[p74] = {}
		}
	end
	local v_u_76 = p72._active_modifiers[p73][p74]
	if typeof(p_u_75) ~= "Instance" then
		if typeof(p_u_75) == "number" then
			local v77 = v_u_76[1]
			if typeof(v77) == "number" then
				if p74 == "add" or p74 == "force_add" then
					v_u_76[1] = v77 + p_u_75
					return p72
				elseif p74 == "multiply" or p74 == "force_multiply" then
					v_u_76[1] = v77 * p_u_75
					return p72
				elseif p74 == "force" or p74 == "force_final" then
					v_u_76[1] = p_u_75
					return p72
				else
					table.insert(v_u_76, p_u_75)
					return p72
				end
			end
			table.insert(v_u_76, 1, p_u_75)
		end
		return p72
	end
	p72.trove:Add(p_u_75.Destroying:Once(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_76, (copy) p_u_75
		local v78 = table.find(v_u_76, p_u_75)
		if v78 then
			table.remove(v_u_76, v78)
		end
	end))
	table.insert(v_u_76, p_u_75)
	return p72
end
function v_u_23.CreateModifier(p79, p80, p81) -- name: CreateModifier
	local v82 = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	v82.Name = ("%*_%*"):format(p80, p81)
	if p81 == "multiply" or p81 == "force_multiply" then
		v82.Value = 1
	end
	p79.trove:Add(v82)
	p79:AddModifier(p80, p81, v82)
	return v82
end

function v_u_23.AddProgress(p89, p90, p91) -- name: AddProgress

		return p89
	end

		p90 = math.min(p90, v92)

function v_u_23.IsInBar(p101, p102, p103) -- name: IsInBar
	if p101.barSize <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	local v104 = (p103 or 0) / 2
	local v105
	if p101.barPosition - p101.barSize / 2 - v104 < p102 then
		v105 = p102 < p101.barPosition + p101.barSize / 2 + v104
	else
		v105 = false
	end
	return v105
end

function v_u_23.Preload(p_u_110, p_u_111) -- name: Preload
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5
	p_u_110._preload_tasks = p_u_110._preload_tasks + 1
	p_u_110.trove:Add(task.spawn(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_111, (ref) v_u_5, (copy) p_u_110
		for _, v112 in ipairs(p_u_111) do
			if typeof(v112) == "Instance" and (v112:IsA("Sound") and (v112:HasTag("LazyLoadSound") and v112:GetAttribute("SoundId"))) then
				v112.SoundId = v112:GetAttribute("SoundId")
				v112:RemoveTag("LazyLoadSound")
			else
				if typeof(v112) ~= "Instance" then
					continue
				end
				for _, v113 in v112:QueryDescendants("Sound.LazyLoadSound") do
					v113.SoundId = v113:GetAttribute("SoundId")
					v113:RemoveTag("LazyLoadSound")
				end
			end
		end
		v_u_5:PreloadAsync(p_u_111)
		local v114 = p_u_110
		v114._preload_tasks = v114._preload_tasks - 1
		if p_u_110._preload_tasks <= 0 and (p_u_110._awaiting_preload and not p_u_110.ready) then
			p_u_110._awaiting_preload = false
			p_u_110.active = true
			p_u_110.ready = true
			p_u_110.OnReady:Fire()
		end
	end))
end

function v_u_53.Purchase(_, p352, p353) -- name: Purchase
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_40, (ref) v_u_41, (copy) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_43, (copy) v_u_258, (copy) v_u_140, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_53
	local v354 = v_u_40
	if not v354 or v_u_41 then
		return false, nil
	end
	v_u_41 = true
	local v355, v356, v357 = v_u_32:InvokeServer(p352, p353 or 1)
	v_u_41 = false
	if v_u_40 ~= v354 then
		return v355 == true, v356
	end
	if typeof(v357) == "table" then
		v354.State = v357
		if v_u_43 then
			v_u_258(v357)
		end
	end
	if v355 then
		v_u_140(v354, math.random() < 0.5 and "Purchase1" or "Purchase2", v_u_16.Purchase)
	elseif v356 == "afford" then
		v_u_140(v354, "CantAfford", v_u_16.Broke)
	elseif v356 == "owned" then
		v_u_140(v354, "Owned", v_u_16.Owned)
	elseif v356 == "soldout" then
		v_u_140(v354, "Owned", v_u_16.SoldOut)
	elseif v356 == "far" then
		v_u_53:Close()
	end

				p42.ImageTransparency = p41.Transparency
			elseif p42:IsA("UIStroke") and p41:IsA("UIStroke") then
				p42.Color = p41.Color
				p42.Transparency = p41.Transparency
			elseif p42:IsA("TextLabel") and p41:IsA("TextLabel") then
				p42.Text = p41.Text
				p42.TextColor3 = p41.TextColor3
				p42.TextTransparency = p41.TextTransparency
			end
			for _, v44 in p41:GetChildren() do
				if v44:IsA("UIPadding") or v44:IsA("UITextSizeConstraint") then
					continue
				end
				local v45 = v44:Clone()
				if v45.Name == "Flare" and (v45:IsA("GuiObject") and p42:IsA("GuiObject")) then
					v45.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
					v45.ZIndex = p42.ZIndex - 1
				end
				v45.Parent = p42
			end
		else
			warn("can\'t copyStyle because \'from\' has to be the same class as \'to\'")
		end
	else
		return
	end
end
function v39._SortPodiums(p47) -- name: _SortPodiums
	local v48 = #p47._ActivePodiums
	local v49 = p47._PodiumOrigin.WorldCFrame
	local v50 = (v48 - 1) * 10
	for v51, v52 in p47._ActivePodiums do
		if v48 <= 1 then
			v52:PivotTo(v49)
		else
			local v53 = CFrame.new
			local v54 = -v50
			local v55 = (v51 - 1) / (v48 - 1)
			v52:PivotTo(v49 * v53(math.lerp(v54, v50, v55), 0, 0))
		end
	end
end

function v39.CreatePodium(p172, p173, p174, p175) -- name: CreatePodium
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_36, (copy) v_u_30, (ref) v_u_40
	local v176 = p173:GetScale()
	local v177 = 2
	local v178 = p174 and 16 or 32
	local v179 = p173:GetExtentsSize() * 2
	local v180 = v179.X
	local v181 = v179.Y
	local v182 = v179.Z
	local v183 = math.max(v180, v181, v182)
	if v178 < v183 then
		v177 = v177 / (v183 / v178)
	end
	p173:ScaleTo(v177 * v176)
	local v184 = p173.PrimaryPart
	if not v184 then
		v184 = p173:FindFirstChild("Center") or p173:FindFirstChild("handle") or (p173:FindFirstChild("Root") or p173:FindFirstChild("RootPart") or (p173:FindFirstChild("Handle") or p173:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)))
		if not (v184 and v184:IsA("BasePart")) then
			v184 = p173:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		end
		p173.PrimaryPart = v184
	end
	local v185 = v184 ~= nil
	local v186 = ("Display model has no root part: %*"):format((p173:GetFullName()))
	assert(v185, v186)
	local v187
	if p175 then
		v187 = p175 * v177
	else
		local v188
		v188, v187 = p173:GetBoundingBox()
		v184.PivotOffset = v184.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(v188)
	end
	local v189 = script.Podium:Clone()
	local v190 = v189:GetPivot()
	local v191 = v187.Y / 2
	p173:PivotTo(v190 + Vector3.new(0, v191, 0))
	p173.Parent = v189
	v189.Parent = v_u_36
	v_u_30:Add(v189)
	local v192 = p172._ActivePodiums
	table.insert(v192, v189)
	p172:_SortPodiums()
	if p174 then
		v_u_40 = p172._PodiumOrigin.WorldPosition
		return v189
	end
	local v193 = v189:GetPivot()
	local v194 = v187.Y / 2
	v_u_40 = (v193 + Vector3.new(0, v194, 0)).Position
	return v189
end

local function v_u_87(p83, p84) -- name: applyAlpha
	for _, v85 in p83 do
		local v86 = v85.Instance
		if not v86.Parent then
			continue
		end

			v86.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - (1 - v85.Background) * p84
		end
		if v85.Image then
			v86.ImageTransparency = 1 - (1 - v85.Image) * p84
		end
		if v85.Text then
			v86.TextTransparency = 1 - (1 - v85.Text) * p84
			v86.TextStrokeTransparency = 1 - (1 - v85.TextStroke) * p84
		end

			v86.Transparency = 1 - (1 - v85.Stroke) * p84
		end
		if not v85.Shadow then
			continue
		end
		v86.Transparency = 1 - (1 - v85.Shadow) * p84
	end
end

local function v_u_144(p124, p125) -- name: setCheckmarkVisibility
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_15, (ref) v_u_26
	local v126 = v_u_15:FindFirstChild("hud")
	local v127
	if v126 then
		local v128 = v126:FindFirstChild("safezone")
		if v128 then
			v127 = v128:FindFirstChild("Boss") or nil
		else
			v127 = nil
		end
	else
		v127 = nil
	end
	local v129
	if v127 then
		v129 = v127:FindFirstChild("ItemsList")
	else
		v129 = nil
	end
	local v130
	if v129 then
		v130 = v129:FindFirstChild(p124)
	else
		v130 = nil
	end
	local v131
	if v130 then
		v131 = v130:FindFirstChild("Checkmark")
	else
		v131 = nil
	end
	if v131 then
		local v132 = v131:IsA("ImageLabel")
		assert(v132, "Luau")
		v131.Visible = p125
	end
	local v133 = v_u_26
	if v133 then
		v133 = v_u_26:FindFirstChild(p124)
	end
	if v133 then
		local v134 = v133:IsA("Folder")
		assert(v134, "Luau")
		for _, v135 in v133:GetChildren() do
			if not v135:IsA("BasePart") then
				continue
			end
			local v136 = v135:GetAttribute("DefaultMaterial")
			if not v136 then
				v136 = v135.Material
				v135:SetAttribute("DefaultMaterial", v136)
			end
			local v137 = v135:GetAttribute("DefaultColor")
			if not v137 then
				v137 = v135.Color
				v135:SetAttribute("DefaultColor", v137)
			end
			if p125 then
				v135.Transparency = 0
				v135.Color = v137
				v135.Material = v136
			else
				v135.Transparency = 0.5
				v135.Color = Color3.fromRGB(91, 93, 105)
				v135.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			end
		end
	end
	local v138
	if v_u_26 then
		v138 = v_u_26:FindFirstChild("Resources")
	else
		v138 = nil
	end
	local v139
	if v138 then
		v139 = v138:FindFirstChild("Main")
	else
		v139 = nil
	end
	local v140
	if v139 then
		v140 = v139:FindFirstChild("List")
	else
		v140 = nil
	end
	local v141
	if v140 then
		v141 = v140:FindFirstChild(p124)
	else
		v141 = nil
	end
	local v142
	if v141 then
		v142 = v141:FindFirstChild("Checkmark")
	else
		v142 = nil
	end
	if v142 then
		local v143 = v142:IsA("ImageLabel")
		assert(v143, "Luau")
		v142.Visible = p125
	end
end

function v_u_50.createCharmButton(p_u_63) -- name: createCharmButton
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_55, (copy) v_u_28, (copy) v_u_50, (copy) v_u_47, (ref) v_u_54, (copy) v_u_41, (copy) v_u_40, (copy) v_u_32
	local v_u_64 = v_u_12[p_u_63]
	if not v_u_64 then
		warn((("Unknown Charm \"%*\""):format(p_u_63)))
		return nil
	end
	local v_u_65 = v_u_13[v_u_64.TargetStat]
	if not v_u_65 then
		warn((("Unknown stat \"%*\" boosted by \"%*\""):format(v_u_64.TargetStat, p_u_63)))
		return nil
	end
	local v_u_66 = v_u_55:Add(script.charmTemplate:Clone())
	v_u_66.LayoutOrder = v_u_64.Order
	v_u_66.charmIcon.Image = v_u_64.Icon
	local v_u_67 = false
	local v_u_68 = false
	v_u_55:Add(v_u_28:Observe({ "Charms", "Equipped", p_u_63 }, function(p69)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_66, (ref) v_u_67
		v_u_66.equipped.Visible = p69 ~= nil
		v_u_67 = p69 ~= nil
	end))
	v_u_55:Add(v_u_28:Observe({ "Charms", "Owned", p_u_63 }, function(p70)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_68, (ref) v_u_50, (copy) v_u_66, (copy) v_u_64, (copy) v_u_65, (ref) v_u_47
		v_u_68 = p70 ~= nil
		if p70 then
			v_u_50.styleCharmButton(v_u_66, v_u_64.Color, false)
			v_u_66.charmName.Text = v_u_64.Name
			v_u_66.stat.Text = v_u_65.DisplayName
			v_u_66.level.Text = ("Lv. %*"):format(p70.Level)
			v_u_66.level.Visible = true
		else
			v_u_50.styleCharmButton(v_u_66, v_u_47, true)
			v_u_66.charmName.Text = "???"
			v_u_66.stat.Text = "Locked"
			v_u_66.level.Visible = false
		end
	end))
	local v_u_71 = false
	v_u_55:Add(v_u_66.Activated:Connect(function(p72, p73)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_68, (ref) v_u_71, (ref) v_u_54, (ref) v_u_67, (ref) v_u_41, (copy) p_u_63, (ref) v_u_40, (ref) v_u_50
		if v_u_68 and (p72:IsModifierKeyDown(Enum.ModifierKey.Shift) or (p73 + 1) % 2 == 0) then
			if not v_u_71 then
				v_u_71 = true
				v_u_54 = true
				if v_u_67 then
					v_u_41:InvokeServer(p_u_63)
				else
					v_u_40:InvokeServer(p_u_63)
				end
				v_u_71 = false
				v_u_54 = false
			end
		else
			v_u_50.loadCharmDetails(p_u_63)
			return
		end
	end))
	v_u_66.Parent = v_u_32.charmList.charmList
	return v_u_66
end

local v_u_114 = nil
function v_u_50.updateSceneAmulet() -- name: updateSceneAmulet
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_28, (copy) v_u_39, (copy) v_u_12, (ref) v_u_114, (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_48, (copy) v_u_1
	local v115 = v_u_14.getMaxCharmsForPlayer(v_u_2)
	local v116 = table.create(9)
	for v117, v118 in v_u_28:TryIndex({ "Charms", "Equipped" }) do
		v116[v118] = v117
	end
	local v119 = v_u_28:TryIndex({ "Charms", "UniversalUnlocked" })
	for _, v120 in v_u_39:GetChildren() do
		if not v120:IsA("BasePart") then
			continue
		end
		if v120.Name == "NecklaceThing" then
			local v121
			if v119 then
				v121 = Color3.fromRGB(58, 126, 91)
			else
				v121 = Color3.fromRGB(108, 88, 75)
			end
			v120.Color = v121
		else
			if v120.Name ~= "Metal" then
				continue
			end
			local v122
			if v119 then
				v122 = Color3.fromRGB(183, 157, 138)
			else
				v122 = Color3.fromRGB(163, 162, 165)
			end
			v120.Color = v122
		end
	end
	for v123 = 1, 9 do
		local v124 = v_u_39:FindFirstChild((("slot%*"):format(v123)))
		if v124 then
			v124.Transparency = v115 < v123 and 1 or 0
			if v115 < v123 then
				continue
			end
			if v116[v123] then
				local v125 = v_u_12[v116[v123]]
				if v125 then
					local v126, v127, v128 = v125.Color:ToHSV()
					local v129 = Color3.fromHSV(v126, math.clamp(v127, 0.5, 0.8), (math.max(v128, 0.7)))
					if v_u_114 and not v_u_114[v123] then
						if v_u_24:GetSettingValue("photosensitiveMode") then
							v_u_4:Create(v124, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
								["Color"] = v129
							}):Play()
						else
							v124.Color = v129
							v_u_4:Create(v124, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
								["Color"] = v129
							}):Play()
							local v130 = ColorSequence.new(v129)
							for _, v131 in ipairs(v124.activateParticles:GetChildren()) do
								v131.Color = v130
								v131:Emit(v131:GetAttribute("EmitCount"))
							end
						end
						v_u_16:PlaySound(script.sfx.equip, v_u_32, true)
					else
						v124.Color = v129
					end
				else
					warn((("Unknown charm \"%*\" equipped??"):format(v116[v123])))
				end
			elseif v_u_114 and v_u_114[v123] then
				local v132 = {
					["Color"] = v_u_48
				}
				v_u_4:Create(v124, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), v132):Play()
				v_u_16:PlaySound(v_u_1.resources.sounds.sfx.ui.equip, v_u_32, true)
			else
				v124.Color = v_u_48
			end
		else
			warn((("Slot %* not found in CharmAmulet!"):format(v123)))
		end
	end
	v_u_114 = v116
	v_u_32.charmList.header.Text = ("Available Charms (%*/%*)"):format(v_u_14.countActiveCharms(v_u_2), (v_u_14.getMaxCharmsForPlayer(v_u_2)))
end

		return
	elseif v_u_27.HasItem("Crest Amulet", nil, true) then

			v_u_52 = true

						v_u_135.Enabled = false
					end
				end))
			end
			v_u_31.Enabled = false
			v_u_55:Add(v_u_31:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_31, (ref) v_u_51, (ref) v_u_53
				if v_u_31.Enabled and (v_u_51 and not v_u_53) then
					v_u_31.Enabled = false
				end
			end))
			v_u_29:SetEnabled("charmMenu", false)
			for v136, _ in v_u_12 do
				v_u_50.createCharmButton(v136)
			end
			v_u_28:WaitForLoaded()
			v_u_55:Add(v_u_28:Observe({ "Charms", "Equipped" }, v_u_50.updateSceneAmulet))
			v_u_55:Add(v_u_28:Observe({ "Skycrest", "Favor", "Level" }, v_u_50.updateSceneAmulet))
			local function v145()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_55, (ref) v_u_39, (ref) v_u_38
				local v137 = v_u_2.Character
				if v137 then
					v137 = v_u_2.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
				end
				local v138 = v137 and v137:GetAppliedDescription() or v_u_3:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserIdAsync(v_u_2.UserId)
				v138.NeckAccessory = ""
				local v139 = v_u_55:Add(v_u_3:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescriptionAsync(v138, Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6))
				local v140 = v139:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
				if v140 then
					v140.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
					v140.EvaluateStateMachine = false
					v140.RequiresNeck = false
					v140.AutoRotate = false
					v140.AutoJumpEnabled = false
					v140.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
					(v140:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", v140)):LoadAnimation(script.idle):Play(nil, nil, 0.25)
				end
				for _, v141 in v139:QueryDescendants("BaseScript, Sound") do
					v141:Destroy()
				end
				local v142 = v139:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if v142 and v142:IsA("BasePart") then
					v142.Anchored = true
				end
				local v143 = v139:FindFirstChild("Torso")
				if v143 and (v143:IsA("BasePart") and v_u_39.NecklaceThing:FindFirstChild("ATTACH")) then
					v_u_39.NecklaceThing.Anchored = false
					v_u_39.NecklaceThing.ATTACH.Part0 = v143

				end
				v139.Parent = workspace.active

	local v242 = v241.month + 1

		v243 = v243 + 1
		v242 = 1
	end

		["month"] = nil,
		["day"] = 1,
		["hour"] = 0,
		["min"] = 0,
		["sec"] = 0,

		["month"] = v242
	}) - v240
	return math.max(0, v244)
end

v_u_113 = function() -- name: renderInvite
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_102, (copy) v_u_330, (ref) v_u_331, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_332, (ref) v_u_114, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_392

		v_u_331 = v_u_331 + 1

		local v394 = {}

			for v396, v397 in pairs(v_u_102.JoinRequests) do
				local v398 = tonumber(v396)
				if not v398 or v394[v398] then
					continue
				end
				v394[v398] = true
				local v399 = {

					["displayName"] = nil,

					["username"] = v397.Name,

				}

			end
		end
		local v400 = {}
		for _, v401 in ipairs(v_u_1:GetPlayers()) do
			local v402 = v401.UserId
			if v394[v402] then
				continue
			end
			local v403
			if v_u_102 then
				local v404 = tostring(v402)
				v403 = v_u_102.Members and v_u_102.Members[v404] and "Member" or (v_u_102.JoinRequests and v_u_102.JoinRequests[v404] and "Requested" or (v_u_102.Invites and v_u_102.Invites[v404] and "Invited" or "Invite"))
			else
				v403 = "Invite"
			end
			if v403 == "Member" then
				continue
			end
			v394[v402] = true
			table.insert(v400, v402)
			local v405 = {
				["userId"] = nil,
				["displayName"] = nil,
				["username"] = nil,
				["level"] = nil,
				["requested"] = false,
				["userId"] = v402,
				["displayName"] = v401.DisplayName,
				["username"] = v401.Name,
				["level"] = v_u_332[v402]
			}
			table.insert(v395, v405)
		end
		if v_u_114 and not v394[v_u_114.userId] then
			local v406 = v_u_114.userId
			local v407
			if v_u_102 then
				local v408 = tostring(v406)
				v407 = v_u_102.Members and v_u_102.Members[v408] and "Member" or (v_u_102.JoinRequests and v_u_102.JoinRequests[v408] and "Requested" or (v_u_102.Invites and v_u_102.Invites[v408] and "Invited" or "Invite"))
			else
				v407 = "Invite"
			end
			if v407 ~= "Member" then
				v394[v_u_114.userId] = true
				local v409 = {
					["userId"] = nil,
					["displayName"] = nil,
					["username"] = nil,
					["level"] = nil,
					["requested"] = false,
					["userId"] = v_u_114.userId,
					["displayName"] = v_u_114.name,
					["username"] = v_u_114.name,
					["level"] = v_u_114.level or v_u_332[v_u_114.userId]
				}
				table.insert(v395, v409)
			end
		end
		if #v400 > 0 then
			local v410 = v_u_8.GetLevels(v400)
			if v393 ~= v_u_331 then
				return
			end
			for _, v411 in ipairs(v395) do
				local v412 = v411.userId

				if v413 == nil then

	end
end
local function v_u_422() -- name: runSearch
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_53, (ref) v_u_114, (ref) v_u_113, (ref) v_u_103, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_84, (copy) v_u_54, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_85
	local v_u_419 = v_u_53.Text:gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
	if v_u_419 == "" then
		v_u_114 = nil
		v_u_113()
		return
	elseif not v_u_103 then
		v_u_103 = true
		v_u_7:PlaySound(v_u_84.click2, v_u_54, false)
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_419, (ref) v_u_114, (ref) v_u_113, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_103
			local v420 = v_u_8.LookupUser(v_u_419)
			if v420.success and (v420.userId and v420.name) then
				v_u_114 = {
					["userId"] = v420.userId,
					["name"] = v420.name,
					["level"] = v420.level
				}
				v_u_113()
			else
				v_u_114 = nil
				local v421 = v420.error or "Couldn\'t find that player."
				if v421 then
					v_u_85:Fire(v421)
				end
				v_u_113()
			end
			v_u_103 = false
		end)
	end
end

local function v_u_185(p179) -- name: ComputeNameValue
	local v180 = 0
	for v181 = 1, #p179 do
		local v182 = string.sub(p179, v181, v181)
		local v183 = string.byte(v182)
		local v184 = #p179 - v181 + 1
		if #p179 % 2 == 1 then
			v184 = v184 - 1
		end
		if v184 % 4 >= 2 then
			v183 = -v183
		end
		v180 = v180 + v183
	end
	return v180
end

function v_u_39.updateConfirmationState(p_u_96) -- name: updateConfirmationState
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_34, (ref) v_u_38, (copy) v_u_39, (copy) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_36, (copy) v_u_35, (ref) v_u_26
	if p_u_96 then
		local function v97() -- name: refresh
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_38, (copy) p_u_96, (ref) v_u_39
			if v_u_38 == p_u_96 then
				v_u_39.updateConfirmationState(p_u_96)
			end
		end
		local v98 = p_u_96.player1 == v_u_25 and "player1" or "player2"
		local v99 = v98 == "player1" and "player2" or "player1"
		local v100 = v_u_35
		v_u_36.Header.Confirmed.Visible = p_u_96[("%*Confirmed"):format(v98)]
		v100.Header.Confirmed.Visible = p_u_96[("%*Confirmed"):format(v99)]
		if p_u_96.acceptTimer == 0 then
			if p_u_96[("%*Confirmed"):format(v98)] then
				v_u_34.Options.Ready.Waiting.Text = "Waiting for other player..."
			else
				v_u_34.Options.Ready.Waiting.Text = ""
			end
			local v101 = v_u_26 - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
			if v101 > 0 then
				v_u_34.Options.Ready.Label.Text = ("Ready (%*)"):format((math.ceil(v101)))
				task.delay(0.5, v97)
				return
			elseif p_u_96[("%*Confirmed"):format(v98)] then
				v_u_34.Options.Ready.Label.Text = "Unready"
			else
				v_u_34.Options.Ready.Label.Text = "Ready"
			end
		else
			v_u_34.Options.Ready.Label.Text = "Unready"
			local v102 = v_u_34.Options.Ready.Waiting
			local v103 = p_u_96.acceptTimer - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
			local v104 = math.max(0, v103)
			v102.Text = ("Accepting in %*s"):format((math.ceil(v104)))
			task.delay(0.5, v97)
			return
		end
	else
		v_u_34.Options.Ready.Label.Text = "Ready"
		v_u_34.Options.Ready.Waiting.Text = ""
		return
	end
end

function v_u_1.initialize(_, p_u_137) -- name: initialize

	v_u_3:performTaskOnGAThread(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_134, (copy) p_u_137, (ref) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_35, (ref) v_u_5, (ref) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_9, (ref) v_u_21
		for _, v138 in ipairs(v_u_134) do
			if p_u_137[v138] ~= nil then
				continue
			end
			v_u_2:e("Initialize \'" .. v138 .. "\' option missing")
			return
		end
		if p_u_137.enableInfoLog ~= nil and p_u_137.enableInfoLog then
			v_u_1:setEnabledInfoLog(p_u_137.enableInfoLog)
		end
		if p_u_137.enableVerboseLog ~= nil and p_u_137.enableVerboseLog then
			v_u_1:setEnabledVerboseLog(p_u_137.enableVerboseLog)
		end
		if p_u_137.availableCustomDimensions01 ~= nil and #p_u_137.availableCustomDimensions01 > 0 then
			v_u_1:configureAvailableCustomDimensions01(p_u_137.availableCustomDimensions01)
		end
		if p_u_137.availableCustomDimensions02 ~= nil and #p_u_137.availableCustomDimensions02 > 0 then
			v_u_1:configureAvailableCustomDimensions02(p_u_137.availableCustomDimensions02)
		end
		if p_u_137.availableCustomDimensions03 ~= nil and #p_u_137.availableCustomDimensions03 > 0 then
			v_u_1:configureAvailableCustomDimensions03(p_u_137.availableCustomDimensions03)
		end
		if p_u_137.availableResourceCurrencies ~= nil and #p_u_137.availableResourceCurrencies > 0 then
			v_u_1:configureAvailableResourceCurrencies(p_u_137.availableResourceCurrencies)
		end
		if p_u_137.availableResourceItemTypes ~= nil and #p_u_137.availableResourceItemTypes > 0 then
			v_u_1:configureAvailableResourceItemTypes(p_u_137.availableResourceItemTypes)
		end
		if p_u_137.build ~= nil and #p_u_137.build > 0 then
			v_u_1:configureBuild(p_u_137.build)
		end
		if p_u_137.availableGamepasses ~= nil and #p_u_137.availableGamepasses > 0 then
			v_u_1:configureAvailableGamepasses(p_u_137.availableGamepasses)
		end
		if p_u_137.enableDebugLog ~= nil then
			v_u_1:setEnabledDebugLog(p_u_137.enableDebugLog)
		end
		if p_u_137.automaticSendBusinessEvents ~= nil then
			v_u_1:setEnabledAutomaticSendBusinessEvents(p_u_137.automaticSendBusinessEvents)
		end
		if p_u_137.reportErrors ~= nil then
			v_u_1:setEnabledReportErrors(p_u_137.reportErrors)
		end
		if p_u_137.useCustomUserId ~= nil then
			v_u_1:setEnabledCustomUserId(p_u_137.useCustomUserId)
		end
		if v_u_35({
			["needsInitialized"] = true,
			["shouldWarn"] = false
		}) then
			v_u_2:w("SDK already initialized. Can only be called once.")
			return
		else
			local v139 = p_u_137.gameKey
			local v140 = p_u_137.secretKey
			if v_u_5:validateKeys(v139, v140) then
				v_u_7.GameKey = v139
				v_u_7.SecretKey = v140

					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

				end)

					local v147 = v144.Args
					v145(v146, unpack(v147))

				v_u_21 = nil

			else
				v_u_2:w("SDK failed initialize. Game key or secret key is invalid. Can only contain characters A-z 0-9, gameKey is 32 length, secretKey is 40 length. Failed keys - gameKey: " .. v139 .. ", secretKey: " .. v140)
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function v341(p_u_333, ...) -- name: _resolve

local function v_u_610(p595, ...) -- name: world_query
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_528, (copy) v_u_576
	local v596 = { ... }
	local v597 = p595.archetypes
	local v598 = p595.componentIndex
	local v599 = nil
	local v600 = 0
	local v601 = {}
	for _, v602 in v596 do
		local v603 = v598[v602]
		if not v603 then
			return v_u_528
		end
		if v599 ~= nil and v603.size >= v599.size then
			continue
		end
		v599 = v603
	end
	if not v599 then
		return v_u_528
	end
	for v604 in v599.cache do
		local v605 = v597[v604]
		if #v605.entities == 0 then
			continue
		end
		local v606 = v605.records
		local v607 = false
		for _, v608 in v596 do
			if v606[v608] then
				continue
			end
			v607 = true
		end
		if v607 then
			break
		end
		v600 = v600 + 1
		v601[v600] = v605
	end
	if v600 == 0 then
		return v_u_528
	end
	local v609 = v_u_576
	return setmetatable({
		["compatible_archetypes"] = v601,
		["ids"] = v596
	}, v609)
end

		["suggestion_generator"] = function(p257) -- name: suggestion_generator
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_256
			local v258 = p257:split(".")
			local v259 = require(v_u_1.client.legacyControllers.DataController).PlayerDataReplicator.Data
			local v260 = require(v_u_1.client.modules.legacyLocalPlayerData).fetch()
			if v258[2] then
				if v258[1] == "NewFormat" then
					for v261, v262 in v258 do
						if typeof(v259) ~= "table" then
							return {}, false
						end
						if v261 == 1 then
							continue
						end
						if v261 == #v258 then
							local v263 = {}
							for v264 in v259 do
								table.insert(v263, v264)
							end
							return v_u_256(v262, table.concat(v258, ".", 1, #v258 - 1) .. ".", v263), true
						end
						if tonumber(v262) then
							v259 = v259[tonumber(v262)] or v259[v262]
						else
							v259 = v259[v262]
						end
					end
				else
					for v265, v266 in v258 do
						if not v260 then
							return {}, false
						end
						if v265 == #v258 then
							local v267 = {}
							for _, v268 in v260:GetChildren() do
								local v269 = v268.Name
								table.insert(v267, v269)
							end
							return v_u_256(v266, table.concat(v258, ".", 1, #v258 - 1) .. ".", v267), true
						end
						v260 = v260:FindFirstChild(v266)
					end
				end
				return {}, false
			end
			local v270 = { "NewFormat" }
			for _, v271 in v260:GetChildren() do
				if #v271:GetChildren() <= 0 then
					continue
				end
				local v272 = v271.Name
				table.insert(v270, v272)
			end
			return v_u_256(p257, "", v270), true
		end
	}

			local v30 = p23[(v29 - 1 - 1) % v25 + 1]

function v1.GetBiasedTargetX(p49, p50, p51) -- name: GetBiasedTargetX
	if p49.random:NextNumber(0, 1) >= 0.5 then
		return p49.random:NextNumber(p50, p51)
	end
	local v52 = p49.current.barPosition + p49.random:NextNumber(-0.15, 0.15)
	return math.clamp(v52, p50, p51)
end
function v1.DamageHealth(p53, p54) -- name: DamageHealth
	if p53.fightActive then
		if p53.config.IsGodFight then
			local v55 = p53.health - p54
			p53.health = math.max(0, v55)
			if p53.health <= 0 then
				p53.fightActive = false
				p53:OnFightFailed()
				return
			end
		else
			p53.current:AddProgress(-p54)
		end
	end
end
function v1.GetHealthPercent(p56) -- name: GetHealthPercent
	local v57 = p56.health / p56.maxHealth
	return math.clamp(v57, 0, 1)
end

function v7.Update(p18) -- name: Update
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	if p18.current.active then

		p18.currentCharge = p18.currentCharge + (p18.targetCharge - p18.currentCharge) * p18.config.SmoothingFactor

end

function v1.BarToScreenX(p11, p12) -- name: BarToScreenX
	local v13 = p11.current.reel_bar
	local v14 = v13.AbsolutePosition
	local v15 = v13.AbsoluteSize
	local v16 = p11.current.reel.AbsoluteSize
	return (v14.X + p12 * v15.X) / v16.X
end
function v1.GetBarScreenY(p17) -- name: GetBarScreenY
	return p17.current.reel_bar.Position.Y.Scale
end
function v1.CheckHitScreenX(p18, p19, p20) -- name: CheckHitScreenX
	local v21 = (p18.current.barSize or (p18.config.DodgeBarSize or 0.3)) / 2
	local v22 = p18:BarToScreenX(p18.current.barPosition)
	local v23 = p18.current.reel_bar.Size.X.Scale
	local v24 = (p20 or 0.02) * v23 / 2
	local v25 = p19 - v24
	local v26 = p19 + v24
	local v27 = v22 - v21 * v23
	local v28 = v22 + v21 * v23
	if v27 <= v26 and v25 <= v28 then
		return true, false
	end
	local v29 = (p18.config.NearMissRange or 0.06) * v23
	local v30 = false
	local v31
	if v27 - v29 <= v26 then
		v31 = v25 <= v28 + v29
	else
		v31 = false
	end
	return v30, v31
end

function v1.GetPhaseSpeedMult(p42) -- name: GetPhaseSpeedMult
	return p42.currentPhase >= 4 and 0.5 or (p42.currentPhase >= 3 and 0.7 or (p42.currentPhase >= 2 and 0.85 or 1))
end
function v1.GetBiasedTargetX(p43, p44, p45) -- name: GetBiasedTargetX
	if p43.random:NextNumber(0, 1) >= 0.5 then
		return p43.random:NextNumber(p44, p45)
	end
	local v46 = p43.current.barPosition + p43.random:NextNumber(-0.15, 0.15)
	return math.clamp(v46, p44, p45)
end
function v1.DamageHealth(p47, p48) -- name: DamageHealth
	if p47.fightActive then
		if p47.config.IsGodFight then
			local v49 = p47.health - p48
			p47.health = math.max(0, v49)
			if p47.health <= 0 then
				p47.fightActive = false
				p47:OnFightFailed()
				return
			end
		else
			p47.current:AddProgress(-p48)
		end
	end
end
function v1.GetHealthPercent(p50) -- name: GetHealthPercent
	local v51 = p50.health / p50.maxHealth
	return math.clamp(v51, 0, 1)
end

function v1.SpawnWisp(p_u_84) -- name: SpawnWisp
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8
	local v_u_85 = p_u_84.current.barSize <= p_u_84.config.WispIncreaseThreshold
	if not v_u_85 then
		if p_u_84.current.barSize >= p_u_84.config.WispReduceThreshold then
			v_u_85 = false
		else
			v_u_85 = p_u_84.random:NextInteger(1, 2) == 1
		end
	end
	local v86 = p_u_84.random:NextNumber(p_u_84.config.WispControlMin, p_u_84.config.WispControlMax) * (v_u_85 and 1 or -1)
	if not v_u_85 then
		local v87 = -(p_u_84.current.barSize - 0.05)
		v86 = math.max(v86, v87)
	end
	local v88 = math.abs(v86) // 0.05
	local v89 = math.max(v88, 1)
	local v_u_90 = p_u_84.reel.Parent.AbsoluteSize
	for v91 = 1, v89 do
		p_u_84.current:DelayLogic((v91 - 1) * 0.05, function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_85, (copy) v_u_90, (copy) p_u_84
			local v_u_92 = v_u_85 and script.wispLight:Clone() or script.wispDark:Clone()
			local v93 = (Random.new():NextUnitVector() * Vector3.new(1, 1, 0)).Unit
			local v94 = Vector2.new(v93.X, v93.Y) * v_u_90
			local v95 = UDim2.fromScale(math.random(), math.random())
			v_u_92.Position = v95 + UDim2.fromOffset(v94.X, v94.Y)
			v_u_92.Parent = p_u_84.current.reel_playerbar
			for _, v96 in v_u_92:GetChildren() do
				if not v96:IsA("ImageLabel") then
					continue
				end
				local v97 = v96.ImageTransparency
				v96.ImageTransparency = 1
				p_u_84.current.logicTweens:Create(v96, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
					["ImageTransparency"] = v97
				}):Play()
			end
			local v_u_98 = p_u_84.current.logicTweens:Create(v_u_92, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
				["Position"] = v95
			})
			v_u_98.Completed:Once(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_92, (copy) v_u_98
				v_u_92:Destroy()
				v_u_98:Destroy()
			end)
			v_u_98:Play()
		end)
	end
	v_u_8:PlaySound(script.WispSpawn, p_u_84.reel, true, "FishingSound")
	p_u_84.current:WaitLogic(0.5)
	p_u_84.current.logicTweens:Create(p_u_84.controlModifier, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart), {
		["Value"] = p_u_84.controlModifier.Value + v86
	}):Play()
	p_u_84.targetPS = p_u_84.targetPS * (1 - p_u_84.config.WispProgressSpeedReduce)
	p_u_84.current.logicTweens:Create(p_u_84.progSpeedModifier, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart), {
		["Value"] = p_u_84.targetPS
	}):Play()
	local v_u_99 = v_u_85 and script.glowLight:Clone() or script.glowDark:Clone()
	v_u_99.ImageTransparency = 0
	v_u_99.Visible = true
	v_u_99.Parent = p_u_84.current.reel_playerbar
	local v_u_100 = p_u_84.current.logicTweens:Create(v_u_99, TweenInfo.new(2, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
		["ImageTransparency"] = 1
	})
	v_u_100.Completed:Once(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_99, (copy) v_u_100
		v_u_99:Destroy()
		v_u_100:Destroy()
	end)
	v_u_100:Play()
end
function v1.RunBeams(p101) -- name: RunBeams
	local v102 = p101.current
	local v103 = p101.config
	while v102.active and p101.fightActive do
		local v104 = tick() - p101.fightStartTime
		local v105 = (v103.BeamRamp or 0.02) * v104
		local v106 = p101.random:NextNumber(v103.BeamMinInterval, v103.BeamMaxInterval) * p101:GetPhaseSpeedMult() - v105
		v102:WaitLogic((math.max(1, v106)))
		if not (v102.active and p101.fightActive) then
			break
		end
		task.spawn(p101.SpawnBeam, p101, p101:GetBiasedTargetX(0.08, 0.92))
	end
end
function v1.RunWisps(p107) -- name: RunWisps
	local v108 = p107.current
	local v109 = p107.config
	while v108.active and p107.fightActive do
		local v110 = tick() - p107.fightStartTime
		local v111 = (v109.WispRamp or 0.02) * v110
		local v112 = p107.random:NextNumber(v109.WispMinInterval, v109.WispMaxInterval) * p107:GetPhaseSpeedMult() - v111
		v108:WaitLogic((math.max(1, v112)))
		if not (v108.active and p107.fightActive) then
			break
		end
		task.spawn(p107.SpawnWisp, p107, p107:GetBiasedTargetX(0.08, 0.92))
	end

	local v22 = v21.Position.X.Scale + v21.Position.X.Offset / v21.AbsoluteSize.X
	local v23 = v21.Size.X.Scale
	return v22 - v23 / 2, v22 + v23 / 2
end
function v1.CheckHitScreenX(p24, p25, p26) -- name: CheckHitScreenX
	local v27 = (p24.current.barSize or (p24.config.DodgeBarSize or 0.3)) / 2
	local v28 = p24:BarToScreenX(p24.current.barPosition)
	local v29 = p24.current.reel_bar.Size.X.Scale
	local v30 = (p26 or 0.02) * v29 / 2
	local v31 = p25 - v30
	local v32 = p25 + v30
	local v33 = v28 - v27 * v29
	local v34 = v28 + v27 * v29
	if v33 <= v32 and v31 <= v34 then
		return true, false
	end
	local v35 = (p24.config.NearMissRange or 0.06) * v29
	local v36 = false
	local v37
	if v33 - v35 <= v32 then
		v37 = v31 <= v34 + v35
	else
		v37 = false
	end
	return v36, v37
end

function v1.GetPhaseSpeedMult(p49) -- name: GetPhaseSpeedMult
	return p49.currentPhase >= 4 and 0.75 or (p49.currentPhase >= 3 and 0.8 or (p49.currentPhase >= 2 and 0.85 or 0.92))
end
function v1.GetBiasedTargetX(p50, p51, p52) -- name: GetBiasedTargetX
	if p50.random:NextNumber(0, 1) >= 0.5 then
		return p50.random:NextNumber(p51, p52)
	end
	local v53 = p50.current.barPosition + p50.random:NextNumber(-0.15, 0.15)
	return math.clamp(v53, p51, p52)
end
function v1.DamageHealth(p54, p55) -- name: DamageHealth
	if p54.fightActive then
		if p54.config.IsGodFight then
			local v56 = p54.health - p55
			p54.health = math.max(0, v56)
			if p54.health <= 0 then
				p54.fightActive = false
				p54:OnFightFailed()
				return
			end
		else
			p54.current:AddProgress(-p55)
		end
	end
end
function v1.GetHealthPercent(p57) -- name: GetHealthPercent
	local v58 = p57.health / p57.maxHealth
	return math.clamp(v58, 0, 1)
end

function v1.OnFightComplete(p_u_87) -- name: OnFightComplete
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_2
	if p_u_87.current and p_u_87.current.active then
		p_u_87.fightActive = false
		v_u_7:ShakeScreen(v_u_5.LocalPlayer, 3, 2)
		if p_u_87.healthFill then
			v_u_2:Create(p_u_87.healthFill, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {
				["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 80)
			}):Play()
		end
		if p_u_87.healthText then
			p_u_87.healthText.Text = "SEAL BROKEN"
			p_u_87.healthText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 255, 180)
		end
		if p_u_87.timerLabel then
			p_u_87.timerLabel.Text = "VICTORY"
			p_u_87.timerLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 255, 180)
		end
		task.delay(1.5, function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_87
			if p_u_87.current and p_u_87.current.active then
				p_u_87.current:EndMinigame(true)
			end
		end)
	end
end
function v1.OnFightFailed(p_u_88) -- name: OnFightFailed
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_2
	if p_u_88.current and p_u_88.current.active then
		p_u_88.fightActive = false
		v_u_7:ShakeScreen(v_u_5.LocalPlayer, 5, 1)
		if p_u_88.healthFill then
			v_u_2:Create(p_u_88.healthFill, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {
				["Size"] = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
				["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
			}):Play()
		end
		if p_u_88.healthDamageFill then
			v_u_2:Create(p_u_88.healthDamageFill, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {
				["Size"] = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
			}):Play()
		end
		if p_u_88.healthText then
			p_u_88.healthText.Text = "DEFEATED"
			p_u_88.healthText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
		end
		if p_u_88.timerLabel then
			p_u_88.timerLabel.Text = "DEFEATED"
			p_u_88.timerLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
		end
		task.delay(1.5, function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_88
			if p_u_88.current and p_u_88.current.active then
				p_u_88.current:EndMinigame(false)
			end
		end)
	end
end
function v1.SpawnTrident(p_u_89, p90) -- name: SpawnTrident

	if v_u_91 and (v_u_91.active and p_u_89.fightActive) then
		local v_u_92 = p_u_89.config
		local v_u_93 = v_u_91.reel

		local v_u_95 = p_u_89:BarToScreenX(p90)
		local v_u_96 = p_u_89:GetBarScreenY()

		v98.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.15, 0),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.85, 0),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)
		})
		v98.Parent = v_u_97
		v_u_91.logicTweens:Create(v_u_97, TweenInfo.new(v94 / 4, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, 3, true), {
			["BackgroundTransparency"] = 0.3
		}):Play()
		v_u_91.logicTweens:Create(v_u_97, TweenInfo.new(v94, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
			["Size"] = UDim2.new(0.03, 0, 1, 0)
		}):Play()
		v_u_91:DelayLogic(v94, function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_97
			if v_u_97.Parent then
				v_u_97:Destroy()
			end
		end)
		v_u_91:WaitLogic(v94)
		if v_u_91.active and p_u_89.fightActive then
			local v_u_99 = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
			v_u_99.Size = v_u_8
			v_u_99.Position = UDim2.fromScale(v_u_95, -0.15)
			v_u_99.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
			v_u_99.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			v_u_99.Image = "rbxassetid://82317421402458"
			v_u_99.ImageColor3 = v_u_9
			v_u_99.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
			v_u_99.Rotation = 180
			v_u_99.ZIndex = 16
			v_u_99.Parent = v_u_93
			local v100 = (v_u_92.TridentFallTime or 1.2) * p_u_89:GetPhaseSpeedMult()
			local v_u_101 = v_u_91.logicTweens:Create(v_u_99, TweenInfo.new(v100, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
				["Position"] = UDim2.fromScale(v_u_95, v_u_96 + 0.3)
			})
			local v_u_102 = false
			local v_u_103 = os.clock()
			local v_u_104 = nil
			v_u_104 = v_u_91.OnLogicStep:Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_102, (copy) v_u_91, (copy) p_u_89, (ref) v_u_104, (ref) v_u_103, (copy) v_u_99, (ref) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_93, (copy) v_u_96, (copy) v_u_95, (copy) v_u_92, (ref) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_101
				if v_u_102 or not (v_u_91.active and p_u_89.fightActive) then
					v_u_104:Disconnect()
				else
					local v105 = os.clock()
					if v105 - v_u_103 >= 0.06 then
						v_u_103 = v105
						local v_u_106 = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
						v_u_106.Size = v_u_99.Size
						v_u_106.Position = v_u_99.Position
						v_u_106.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
						v_u_106.BackgroundTransparency = 1
						v_u_106.Image = "rbxassetid://82317421402458"
						v_u_106.ImageColor3 = v_u_9
						v_u_106.ImageTransparency = 0.55
						v_u_106.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
						v_u_106.Rotation = 180
						v_u_106.ZIndex = 15
						v_u_106.Parent = v_u_93
						v_u_91.logicTweens:Create(v_u_106, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
							["ImageTransparency"] = 1
						}):Play()
						v_u_91:DelayLogic(0.25, function()
							-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_106
							if v_u_106.Parent then
								v_u_106:Destroy()
							end
						end)
					end
					if v_u_99.Position.Y.Scale + v_u_99.Size.Y.Scale >= v_u_96 - 0.02 and v_u_99.Position.Y.Scale <= v_u_96 + 0.02 then
						local v107, v108 = p_u_89:CheckHitScreenX(v_u_95, 0.04)
						if v107 then
							v_u_102 = true
							v_u_104:Disconnect()
							p_u_89:DamageHealth(v_u_92.TridentDamage)
							p_u_89:HitEffect(v_u_9)
							v_u_7:PlaySound(script.TridentImpact, v_u_93, true)
							p_u_89:SpawnSplash(v_u_95, v_u_9)
							v_u_7:PlaySound(script.SplashSound, v_u_93, true)
							v_u_101:Cancel()
							v_u_91.logicTweens:Create(v_u_99, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
								["ImageTransparency"] = 1
							}):Play()
							v_u_91:DelayLogic(0.25, function()
								-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_99
								if v_u_99.Parent then
									v_u_99:Destroy()
								end
							end)
							return
						end
						if v108 then
							v_u_102 = true
							v_u_104:Disconnect()
							p_u_89:SpawnDodgeText()
						end
					end
				end

function v1.RunAmbientParticles(p_u_237) -- name: RunAmbientParticles
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_2
	local v_u_238 = p_u_237.current
	local v_u_239 = v_u_238.reel
	local v_u_240 = {}
	local function v_u_246() -- name: spawnBubble
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_237, (ref) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_239, (ref) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_240
		local v241 = p_u_237.random:NextNumber(0.012, 0.025)
		local v242 = p_u_237.random:NextNumber(0, 1) > 0.5
		local v243 = Instance.new("ImageLabel")

		v243.Size = UDim2.fromScale(v241, v241)
		v243.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

		v243.ImageTransparency = 1
		v243.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
		v243.ZIndex = 2
		v243.Parent = v_u_239
		v_u_2:Create(v243, TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), {
			["ImageTransparency"] = p_u_237.random:NextNumber(0.5, 0.75)
		}):Play()
		local v244 = {
			["gui"] = nil,
			["x"] = nil,
			["y"] = nil,
			["speedX"] = nil,
			["drift"] = nil,
			["driftSpeed"] = nil,
			["driftAmount"] = nil,
			["fadingOut"] = false,
			["gui"] = v243,
			["x"] = v242 and -0.05 or 1.05,
			["y"] = p_u_237.random:NextNumber(0.3, 0.95),
			["speedX"] = p_u_237.random:NextNumber(0.025, 0.055) * (v242 and 1 or -1),
			["drift"] = p_u_237.random:NextNumber(0, 6.283185307179586),
			["driftSpeed"] = p_u_237.random:NextNumber(1.5, 3),
			["driftAmount"] = p_u_237.random:NextNumber(0.004, 0.01)
		}
		local v245 = v_u_240
		table.insert(v245, v244)
		return v244
	end
	for _ = 1, 8 do
		v_u_246().x = p_u_237.random:NextNumber(0.05, 0.95)
	end
	local v254 = v_u_238.OnLogicStep:Connect(function(p247)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_238, (copy) p_u_237, (copy) v_u_240, (ref) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_246
		if v_u_238.active and p_u_237.fightActive then
			for v248 = #v_u_240, 1, -1 do
				local v249 = v_u_240[v248]
				v249.x = v249.x + v249.speedX * p247
				v249.drift = v249.drift + v249.driftSpeed * p247
				local v250 = v249.drift
				local v251 = math.sin(v250) * v249.driftAmount
				v249.gui.Position = UDim2.fromScale(v249.x, v249.y + v251)
				local v252
				if v249.speedX > 0 and v249.x > 0.9 then
					v252 = true
				elseif v249.speedX < 0 then
					v252 = v249.x < 0.1
				else
					v252 = false
				end
				if v252 and not v249.fadingOut then
					v249.fadingOut = true
					v_u_2:Create(v249.gui, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), {
						["ImageTransparency"] = 1
					}):Play()
				end
				local v253
				if v249.speedX > 0 and v249.x > 1.15 then
					v253 = true
				elseif v249.speedX < 0 then
					v253 = v249.x < -0.15
				else
					v253 = false
				end
				if not v253 then
					continue
				end
				if v249.gui.Parent then
					v249.gui:Destroy()
				end
				table.remove(v_u_240, v248)
				v_u_246()
			end
		end
	end)
	p_u_237.reelTrove:Add(v254)
	p_u_237.reelTrove:Add(function()

			end

		end
	end)
end
function v1.RunTridents(p256) -- name: RunTridents
	local v257 = p256.current
	local v258 = p256.config
	while v257.active and p256.fightActive do
		local v259 = os.clock() - p256.fightStartTime
		local v260 = (v258.TridentRamp or 0.02) * v259
		local v261 = p256.random:NextNumber(v258.TridentMinInterval, v258.TridentMaxInterval) * p256:GetPhaseSpeedMult() - v260
		v257:WaitLogic((math.max(0.8, v261)))
		if not (v257.active and p256.fightActive) then
			break
		end
		local v262 = p256.currentPhase >= 2 and 2 or 1
		for v263 = 1, v262 do
			if not (v257.active and p256.fightActive) then
				break
			end
			task.spawn(p256.SpawnTrident, p256, p256:GetBiasedTargetX(0.08, 0.92))
			if v263 >= v262 then
				continue
			end
			v257:WaitLogic(0.25)
		end
	end
end
function v1.RunWaves(p264) -- name: RunWaves
	local v265 = p264.current
	local v266 = p264.config
	while v265.active and p264.fightActive do
		local v267 = os.clock() - p264.fightStartTime
		local v268 = (v266.WaveRamp or 0.01) * v267
		local v269 = p264.random:NextNumber(v266.WaveMinInterval, v266.WaveMaxInterval) * p264:GetPhaseSpeedMult() - v268
		v265:WaitLogic((math.max(3, v269)))
		if not (v265.active and p264.fightActive) then
			break
		end
		if p264.currentPhase >= 4 and p264.random:NextNumber(0, 1) < 0.35 then
			task.spawn(p264.SpawnDoubleWave, p264)
		else
			local v270 = p264.random:NextNumber(0, 1) > 0.5
			if p264.currentPhase >= 2 and (not p264.lastWaveHit and p264.random:NextNumber(0, 1) < 0.6) then
				v270 = v265.barPosition < 0.5
			end
			if p264.lastWaveHit and p264.lastWaveSide ~= nil then
				v270 = not p264.lastWaveSide
			end
			p264.lastWaveSide = v270
			p264.lastWaveHit = false
			task.spawn(p264.SpawnWave, p264, v270)
		end
	end
end
function v1.RunWhirlpools(p_u_271) -- name: RunWhirlpools
	local v_u_272 = p_u_271.current
	local v273 = p_u_271.config
	local v274 = v273.WhirlpoolMinInterval or 4
	local v275 = v273.WhirlpoolMaxInterval or 8
	while v_u_272.active and p_u_271.fightActive do
		local v276 = os.clock() - p_u_271.fightStartTime
		local v277 = (v273.WhirlpoolRamp or 0.01) * v276
		local v278 = p_u_271.random:NextNumber(v274, v275) * p_u_271:GetPhaseSpeedMult() - v277
		v_u_272:WaitLogic((math.max(2, v278)))
		if not (v_u_272.active and p_u_271.fightActive) then
			break
		end
		task.spawn(p_u_271.SpawnWhirlpool, p_u_271, p_u_271:GetBiasedTargetX(0.1, 0.9))
		if p_u_271.currentPhase < 3 or p_u_271.random:NextNumber(0, 1) >= 0.2 then
			continue
		end
		v_u_272:DelayLogic(0.5, function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_272, (copy) p_u_271
			if v_u_272.active and p_u_271.fightActive then
				task.spawn(p_u_271.SpawnWhirlpool, p_u_271, p_u_271.random:NextNumber(0.1, 0.9))
			end
		end)
	end
end

function v1.OnClick(p_u_52) -- name: OnClick
	p_u_52:UpdateHovered()

					continue
				end

					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_53, (copy) p_u_52

					end
				end)

				p_u_52:HideWheel()
			elseif p_u_52.signProgress >= #p_u_52.config.Signs then

				v54:WaitLogic(0.5)

local function v_u_281(p238, p239) -- name: getDifficultyConfig
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_237, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_33
	local v240 = table.clone(v_u_237)

	v240.OK_WINDOW = math.max(0.11, v264)

	v240.WRONG_KEY_PENALTY = v_u_237.WRONG_KEY_PENALTY - v256 * 0.3
	local v265 = 1.8 - v256 * 0.3
	local v266 = math.clamp(v265, 0.2, 1.8)

	v240.GOOD_PROGRESS = v240.GOOD_PROGRESS * v266

		v240.NOTE_FALL_TIME = v240.NOTE_FALL_TIME + v280 * v_u_237.NOTE_FALL_TIME
	end

end

	return p23.current.reel_bar.Position.Y.Scale
end
function v1.CheckHitScreenX(p24, p25, p26) -- name: CheckHitScreenX
	local v27 = (p24.current.barSize or (p24.config.DodgeBarSize or 0.3)) / 2
	local v28 = p24:BarToScreenX(p24.current.barPosition)
	local v29 = p24.current.reel_bar.Size.X.Scale
	local v30 = (p26 or 0.02) * v29 / 2
	local v31 = p25 - v30
	local v32 = p25 + v30
	local v33 = v28 - v27 * v29
	local v34 = v28 + v27 * v29
	if v33 <= v32 and v31 <= v34 then
		return true, false
	end
	local v35 = (p24.config.NearMissRange or 0.06) * v29
	local v36 = false
	local v37
	if v33 - v35 <= v32 then
		v37 = v31 <= v34 + v35
	else
		v37 = false
	end
	return v36, v37
end

			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_41, (copy) v_u_42

			v_u_42:Destroy()

		local v43 = v_u_6.LocalPlayer.Character

			v43 = v_u_6.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		end
		if v43 then

		end
	end
end

function v1.GetPhaseSpeedMult(p49) -- name: GetPhaseSpeedMult
	return p49.currentPhase >= 4 and 0.5 or (p49.currentPhase >= 3 and 0.7 or (p49.currentPhase >= 2 and 0.85 or 1))
end
function v1.GetBiasedTargetX(p50, p51, p52) -- name: GetBiasedTargetX
	if p50.random:NextNumber(0, 1) >= 0.5 then
		return p50.random:NextNumber(p51, p52)
	end
	local v53 = p50.current.barPosition + p50.random:NextNumber(-0.15, 0.15)
	return math.clamp(v53, p51, p52)
end
function v1.DamageHealth(p54, p55) -- name: DamageHealth
	if p54.fightActive then
		if p54.config.IsGodFight then
			local v56 = p54.health - p55
			p54.health = math.max(0, v56)
			if p54.health <= 0 then
				p54.fightActive = false
				p54:OnFightFailed()
				return
			end
		else
			p54.current:AddProgress(-p55)
		end
	end
end
function v1.GetHealthPercent(p57) -- name: GetHealthPercent
	local v58 = p57.health / p57.maxHealth
	return math.clamp(v58, 0, 1)
end

function v1.OnFightComplete(p_u_75) -- name: OnFightComplete
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_3
	if p_u_75.current and p_u_75.current.active then
		p_u_75.fightActive = false
		v_u_9:ShakeScreen(v_u_6.LocalPlayer, 3, 2)
		if p_u_75.healthFill then
			v_u_3:Create(p_u_75.healthFill, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {
				["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 80)
			}):Play()
		end
		if p_u_75.healthText then
			p_u_75.healthText.Text = "SEAL BROKEN"
			p_u_75.healthText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 255, 180)
		end
		if p_u_75.timerLabel then
			p_u_75.timerLabel.Text = "VICTORY"
			p_u_75.timerLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 255, 180)
		end
		task.delay(1.5, function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_75
			if p_u_75.current and p_u_75.current.active then
				p_u_75.current:EndMinigame(true)
			end
		end)
	end
end

function v1.UpdateOrbs(p91, p92) -- name: UpdateOrbs
	for _, v93 in p91.orbs do
		for _, v94 in v93.sprites do
			v94:Update()
		end
		if v93.attacking or v93.returning then
			break
		end
		local v95 = v93.targetX - v93.x
		if math.abs(v95) < 0.01 then
			v93.targetX = p91.random:NextNumber(0.15, 0.85)
		end
		local v96 = v93.x
		local v97 = math.sign(v95)
		local v98 = math.abs(v95)
		local v99 = p92 * 0.3
		v93.x = v96 + v97 * math.min(v98, v99)
		v93.phase = v93.phase + p92 * 3
		local v100 = v93.phase
		local v101 = math.sin(v100) * 0.015
		v93.gui.Position = UDim2.fromScale(p91:BarToScreenX(v93.x), v93.baseY + v101)
		for v102, v103 in v93.sprites do
			local v104 = v103.Gui
			v104.Rotation = v104.Rotation + p92 * (40 + v102 * 15)
		end
		local v105 = v93.glow
		local v106 = v93.phase * 1.5
		v105.ImageTransparency = math.sin(v106) * 0.2 + 0.4
	end
end
function v1.OrbAttack(p107, p_u_108) -- name: OrbAttack
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_3
	if p_u_108.attacking then
		return
	else
		p_u_108.attacking = true
		local v109 = p107.current
		local v110 = p107.config
		local v111 = p107:GetBarScreenY()
		local v_u_112 = p107:GetBiasedTargetX(0.1, 0.9)
		local v113 = p107:BarToScreenX(v_u_112)
		local v_u_114 = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		v_u_114.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		v_u_114.Position = UDim2.new(v_u_112, 0, 0.5, 0)
		v_u_114.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		v_u_114.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		v_u_114.Text = "!"
		v_u_114.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		v_u_114.TextScaled = true
		v_u_114.TextColor3 = v_u_13
		v_u_114.TextTransparency = 1
		v_u_114.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		v_u_114.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
		v_u_114.ZIndex = 18
		v_u_114.Parent = v109.reel_bar
		local v115 = Instance.new("UIScale")
		v115.Scale = 2.5
		v115.Parent = v_u_114
		local v116 = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
		v116.AspectRatio = 1
		v116.Parent = v_u_114
		p107.current.logicTweens:Create(v_u_114, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			["TextTransparency"] = 0,
			["TextStrokeTransparency"] = 0.3
		}):Play()
		p107.current.logicTweens:Create(v115, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			["Scale"] = 1
		}):Play()
		local v_u_117 = v110.OrbWarningTime or 0.5
		local v_u_118 = tick()
		local v_u_119 = nil
		v_u_119 = v109.OnLogicStep:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_114, (ref) v_u_119, (copy) v_u_118, (copy) v_u_117, (copy) v_u_112
			if v_u_114.Parent then
				local v120 = tick() - v_u_118
				if v_u_117 <= v120 then
					v_u_119:Disconnect()
				else
					local v121 = 1 + v120 / v_u_117
					local v122 = v120 * 30
					local v123 = math.sin(v122) * 2 * v121
					v_u_114.Position = UDim2.new(v_u_112, v123, 0.5, -14 - v120 * 8)
				end
			else
				v_u_119:Disconnect()
				return
			end
		end)
		p107.current.logicTweens:Create(p_u_108.glow, TweenInfo.new(v_u_117), {
			["ImageTransparency"] = 0,
			["Size"] = nil,
			["Size"] = UDim2.fromScale(3, 3)
		}):Play()
		v109:WaitLogic(v_u_117)
		p107.current.logicTweens:Create(v_u_114, TweenInfo.new(0.05), {
			["TextTransparency"] = 1,
			["TextStrokeTransparency"] = 1
		}):Play()
		v109:DelayLogic(0.1, function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_114
			if v_u_114.Parent then
				v_u_114:Destroy()
			end
		end)
		if v109.active and p107.fightActive then
			local v124 = v110.OrbDashTime or 0.15
			local v125 = {
				["Position"] = UDim2.fromScale(v113, v111)
			}
			local v126 = p107.current.logicTweens:Create(p_u_108.gui, TweenInfo.new(v124, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), v125)
			v126:Play()
			v126.Completed:Wait()
			if v109.active and p107.fightActive then
				local v127, v128 = p107:CheckHitScreenX(v113, 0.05)
				if v127 then
					p107:DamageHealth(v110.OrbDamage)
					p107:HitEffect(v_u_13)
				elseif v128 then
					p107:SpawnDodgeText()
				end
				v109.fx:SpawnShake(v109.reel_bar, 0.3, 1.5, 0.01, true)
				local v_u_129 = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
				v_u_129.Size = UDim2.fromScale(5, 5)
				v_u_129.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
				v_u_129.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
				v_u_129.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				v_u_129.Image = "rbxassetid://12159555294"
				v_u_129.ImageColor3 = v_u_13
				v_u_129.ImageTransparency = 0
				v_u_129.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
				v_u_129.ZIndex = 17
				v_u_129.Parent = p_u_108.gui
				p107.current.logicTweens:Create(v_u_129, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Exponential, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
					["Size"] = nil,
					["ImageTransparency"] = 1,
					["Size"] = UDim2.fromScale(8, 8)
				}):Play()
				v109:DelayLogic(0.45, function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_129
					if v_u_129.Parent then
						v_u_129:Destroy()
					end
				end)
			end
			v109:WaitLogic(0.15)
			p_u_108.attacking = false
			p_u_108.returning = true

			local v234 = v_u_12.ChanceGroups[v230.ChanceGroup]
			if v234 and v234.LuckFactor > 0 then
				v231 = v231 + v232 / 79 * v234.LuckFactor * (v194.RarityLuckFactorBoosts and (v194.RarityLuckFactorBoosts[v230.ChanceGroup] or 1) or 1) * (1 + (p193.BiteStats.LuckMultiply - 1) / 4)
			else
				v231 = v231 * (1 + v232 / 100 / v233)
			end
		end
		if p193.Bait and v_u_11[p193.Bait] then
			local v235 = v229.FavouriteBait
			if typeof(v235) == "table" and table.find(v229.FavouriteBait, p193.Bait) or v229.FavouriteBait == p193.Bait then
				v231 = v231 * (1 + 0.1 * p193.BiteStats.BaitEffectiveness)
			end
		end
		if v229.Seasons and (#v229.Seasons > 0 and v229.Seasons[1] ~= "None") then
			if table.find(v229.Seasons, v_u_24.season.Value) then
				local v236 = 1 + 0.2 * p193.BiteStats.SeasonEffectiveness
				v231 = v231 * math.max(v236, 0)
			else
				local v237 = 1 + -0.1 * p193.BiteStats.SeasonEffectiveness
				v231 = v231 * math.max(v237, 0)
			end
		end
		if v_u_19.IsAnyActive(v229.Weather) then
			local v238 = 1 + 0.35 * p193.BiteStats.WeatherEffectiveness
			v231 = v231 * math.max(v238)
		end
		if p193.Zone then
			local v239 = p193.Zone:FindFirstChild("Abundance")
			if v239 then
				local v240 = v239.Value
				local v241 = tostring(v240)
				local v242 = v239:FindFirstChild("Chance")
				if v241 ~= "Mutation" then
					local v243 = false
					local v244
					if string.sub(v241, 1, 10) == "__series__" then
						v244 = false
						local v245 = v241:sub(11):split("_")
						if table.find(v245, v228) then
							v243 = true
						end
					else
						v244 = true
					end
					if v244 and v241 == v228 and true or v243 then
						if v242 then
							v231 = v231 * (1 + v242.Value / 100)
						else
							v231 = v231 * 1.7
						end

				end
			end
		end

				v231 = v231 * math.max(v246, 0)
			end
			if v229.FavouriteTime == "Night" and v_u_24.event.Value == "Night of the Fireflies" then
				v231 = v231 * 2
			end
		end
		v200[v228] = math.max(v231, 0)
	end
	if p193.Roamers then
		for _, v247 in p193.Roamers do
			local v248 = v247:GetAttribute("FishName")
			if not (v248 and v200[v248]) then
				continue
			end
			local v249 = v_u_9[v248]
			if typeof(v249) ~= "table" then
				continue
			end
			local v250 = v249.ChanceGroup or v_u_12.Rarities[v249.Rarity].ChanceGroup
			if not (v250 and v_u_12.ChanceGroups[v250]) then
				continue
			end
			v200[v248] = v200[v248] * v_u_12.ChanceGroups[v250].RoamerChanceMultiplier
		end
	end
	v_u_1.HookNaturalFishPool:InvokePcallAsync(p192, p193, v200)
	p193:AddWeightedPool(v200)
	local v251 = p193.Bait
	if v251 then
		v251 = v_u_11[p193.Bait]
	end
	if v251 and v251.MultiplyFishChances then
		p193:BoostFishPool(v251.MultiplyFishChances)
	end
	return p192, p193
end
v_u_1.BuildFishPool:BindAtPriority(0, v_u_1.BuildDefaultPool)
v_u_1.BuildFishPool:BindAtPriority(-6000, v_u_1.BuildStrictChancePool)

end)
function v_u_1.Bite(_, p261, p262) -- name: Bite
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10, (ref) v_u_27, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_30, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_37, (copy) v_u_3
	local v263 = p262.Rod
	local v264, v265

		v264 = p261.Character
		local v266 = v264:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
		if v266 and v_u_10[v266.Name] then
			if v263 then
				v265 = p261
			else
				v263 = v266.Name
				v265 = p261
			end
		else
			if not v263 then
				local v267, _ = v_u_27.forPlayerSafe(p261)
				v263 = v267:WaitForChild("Stats"):WaitForChild("rod").Value

			v265 = p261
		end
	else
		v264 = p261.Parent
		v265 = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(v264)
		if not v263 then
			v263 = p261.Name
		end
	end
	local v268 = p262 or {}
	local v269, v270 = v_u_27.forPlayerSafe(v265)
	if not v269 then
		warn((("Bite called for %*, whose data is not currently loaded"):format(v265 and v265.Name or "???")))
		return nil, {
			["Rod"] = v263,
			["SourceType"] = v268.PassiveCapture and "entity" or "catch",
			["SourceName"] = v263
		}
	end
	if v_u_21 and v_u_21:CheckFull(v265) then
		return nil, {
			["Rod"] = v263,
			["SourceType"] = v268.PassiveCapture and "entity" or "catch",
			["SourceName"] = v263
		}
	end
	if not (v263 and v_u_10[v263]) then
		warn((("Unknown fishing rod \"%*\" passed to :Bite"):format(v263)))
		return nil, {
			["Rod"] = v263,
			["SourceType"] = v268.PassiveCapture and "entity" or "catch",
			["SourceName"] = v263
		}
	end
	local _, v271 = v_u_1.BuildBiteMeta:InvokePcallAsync(v265, v268)
	if v268.OverrideFishPool then
		v271:AddWeightedPool(v268.OverrideFishPool)
	else
		v_u_1.BuildFishPool:InvokePcallAsync(v265, v271)
	end
	v_u_1.HookFinalFishPool:InvokePcallAsync(v265, v271)
	local _, _, v272 = v_u_1.ShouldAllowBobber:InvokePcallAsync(v265, v271)
	if v272 == false then
		return nil, v271
	end
	if v264 and (v271.ZoneName and (v_u_6[v271.ZoneName] and (not v271.Zone or v271.Zone.Parent))) then
		local v273 = v_u_6[v271.ZoneName]
		if v273.CustomCondition and (v270 and not v265:GetAttribute("BypassProgressionChecks")) then
			local v274, v275 = v273.CustomCondition(v265, v270, v269)
			if not v274 then
				v_u_30:FireClient(v265, v275, 10, "error")
				return nil, v271
			end
		end
		local _ = v273.Pool
		if v271.Bait and (v271.Bait ~= "None" and (v271.SourceType == "catch" and v_u_2:IsServer())) then
			v_u_25.HasFishWithBait:Fire(v265, v271.Bait)
		end
		local v276 = v271.Zone
		if v276 and v276:FindFirstChild("NewAbundances") then
			for _, v277 in v276.NewAbundances:GetChildren() do
				local v278 = v_u_9[v277.Name]
				if not v278 or v278.WeightPool[1] / 10 > v271.BiteStats.Strength then
					continue
				end
				v271:AddFixedFish(v277.Name, v277.Value)
			end
		end
		local v279 = v271:GetRandomFish()
		if not v279 then
			return nil, v271
		end
		local v280 = v_u_15.new()
		v280:SetMeta(v271)
		v280.Name = v279
		local v281 = v_u_9[v280.Name]
		if _G.ForcedCatches[v265.UserId] ~= nil then
			local v282 = _G.ForcedCatches[v265.UserId]
			if tostring(v282) then
				local v283 = v_u_37
				local v284 = _G.ForcedCatches[v265.UserId]
				if v283((tostring(v284))) ~= nil then
					local v285 = v_u_37
					local v286 = _G.ForcedCatches[v265.UserId]
					v280.Name = v285((tostring(v286)))
					_G.ForcedCatches[v265.UserId] = nil
				end
			end
		end
		if v281.WeightPool[2] - v281.WeightPool[1] > 0 and math.random(10, 1000) / 10 <= 7 * v_u_3:WaitForChild("world"):WaitForChild("luck_Weight").Value then
			if math.random(1, 2) == 1 then
				v280:WeightBoost(math.random(11, 21) / 10)
			else
				v280:WeightBoost(math.random(11, 15) / 10)
			end
		end
		v280:WeightBoost(1 + v271.BiteStats.WeightBoost / 100)
		v280:AddShinyChance(v271.BiteStats.ShinyChance)
		v280:AddSparklingChance(v271.BiteStats.SparklingChance)
		local _, _, v287 = v_u_1.BuildNaturalMutationPool:InvokeAsync(v265, v271)
		local v288 = 0
		for _, v289 in v287 do
			v288 = v288 + v289
		end
		local v290 = {}
		for v291, v292 in v287 do
			v290[v291] = v292 / v288 * v271.BiteStats.NaturalMutationChance
		end
		v280:AddMutationPool(v290)
		v280.CaughtBy = v265.UserId or nil
		if _G.ForcedCatchMutation[v265.UserId] then
			if _G.ForcedCatchMutation[v265.UserId] == "Shiny" then
				v280.Shiny = true
			elseif _G.ForcedCatchMutation[v265.UserId] == "Sparkling" then
				v280.Sparkling = true
			elseif _G.ForcedCatchMutation[v265.UserId] == "Glitched" then
				v280.Glitched = true
			else
				v280.Mutation = _G.ForcedCatchMutation[v265.UserId]
			end
			_G.ForcedCatchMutation[v265.UserId] = nil
		end
		if v271.BiteStats.Strength <= 0.001 then
			v_u_30:FireClient(v265, "<font color=\"#D20103\">Your rod is too weak... Try a stronger rod or enchanting.</font>", 10, "error")
			return nil, v271
		end
		if _G.ForcedCatchNew[v265.UserId] then
			for v293, v295 in _G.ForcedCatchNew[v265.UserId] do
				if v295 == "None" then
					local v295 = nil
				end
				v280[v293] = v295
			end
			_G.ForcedCatchNew[v265.UserId] = nil
		end
		if not v268.IgnoreRemote then
			v_u_25.OnFishLured:Fire(v265, v280, v271)
		end
		return v280, v271
	end
end

						if v311 ~= "Default" and not (v_u_14.RodsSkins.All[v311] or v300.Data.NewFormat.RodSkins[v311] and (v_u_14.RodsSkins[v304] and v_u_14.RodsSkins[v304][v311])) then

						end
						if not v309.caught then
							v309.caught = v310.Caught or 0
						end

function v_u_1.GiveRodItem(_, p339, p340, p341, p342) -- name: GiveRodItem
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_29, (ref) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_25
	if p340 == "Debug Rod" and not v_u_29:HasMinimumRole(p339, "Developer") then
		warn((("%* does not have the sufficient permissions to have Debug Rod!"):format(p339.Name)))
		return nil
	end
	require(game:GetService("ServerScriptService").server.legacyServices:WaitForChild("FunnelsService"))
	local _, v343 = v_u_27.forPlayer(p339)
	local v344 = v343.Data.NewFormat.Rods
	if v344 then
		if v344[p340] then
			return v344[p340]
		end
		if not v_u_10[p340] and v343 then
			for _, v345 in v343.Data.NewFormat.FailedRewards do
				if v345.Type ~= "Rod" or v345.Name ~= p340 then
					continue
				end
				return nil
			end
			local v346 = v343.Data.NewFormat.FailedRewards
			local v347 = {
				["Type"] = "Rod",
				["Name"] = nil,
				["Amount"] = 1,
				["Time"] = nil,
				["Name"] = p340,
				["Time"] = os.time()
			}
			table.insert(v346, v347)
			return nil
		end
		local v348 = v343.Data.NewFormat.RemovedRodData[p340] or {}
		v344[p340] = {
			["caught"] = v348.Caught or 0,
			["enchant"] = v348.Enchant or "none",
			["favorited"] = v348.Favorited or false,
			["secondaryEnchant"] = v348.SecondaryEnchant or "none",
			["skin"] = v348.Skin or "Default",
			["admin"] = p342 or nil
		}
		v343.Data.NewFormat.RemovedRodData[p340] = nil
		if p341 then
			v_u_3:WaitForChild("events"):WaitForChild("anno_unlock"):FireClient(p339, p340)
		end
		v_u_25.OnRodGiven:Fire(p339, p340)
		return v344[p340]
	end
end
function v_u_1.SellFish(p349, p350, p351, p352) -- name: SellFish
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_33, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_26, (copy) v_u_20, (copy) v_u_3
	if p352 == nil then
		p352 = false
	end
	if v_u_2:IsClient() and not p352 then
		return nil
	end
	local v353 = v_u_9[p351.name]
	local v354 = v353.Price
	local v355
	if p351.sub.Weight then
		local v356 = p351.sub.Weight / (v353.WeightPool[2] / 10) * v354
		v355 = math.ceil(v356)
	else
		warn("!! FISH DOES NOT HAVE WEIGHT VALUE")
		local v357 = v353.WeightPool[1] / 10 / (v353.WeightPool[2] / 10) * v354
		v355 = math.ceil(v357)
	end
	if p351.sub.Shiny then
		v355 = v355 * 1.85
	end
	if p351.sub.Sparkling then
		v355 = v355 * 1.85
	end
	local v358 = p351.sub.Glitched and 0 or v355
	if p351.sub.Possessed then
		v358 = v358 * v_u_13.byName.Possessed.PriceMultiply
	end
	if p351.sub.Mutation then
		local v359 = require("@self/mutations").Mutations
		if v359[p351.sub.Mutation] then
			if p351.sub.Mutation == "Seasonal" then
				local v360 = p351.sub.Season
				if v360 then
					local v361 = v360.Value
					if v361 == "Spring" then
						v358 = v358 * 4.5
					elseif v361 == "Winter" then
						v358 = v358 * 2.5
					elseif v361 == "Autumn" then
						v358 = v358 * 4
					end
				end
			else
				v358 = v358 * v359[p351.sub.Mutation].PriceMultiply
			end
		end
	end
	if v_u_33:Get("ServerBoost") and not v353.BuyMult then
		v358 = v358 * (v_u_33:Get("ServerBoost"):Get("C$") or 1)
	end
	if p352 == false then
		local v362 = table.clone(p351.sub)
		v362.Stack = nil
		v_u_21:RemoveItem(p350, p351.name, v362, 1)
		if v_u_27.forPlayerSafe(p350) then
			local v363 = 0

function v_u_3.CanNaturalCatch(_, p22, p23) -- name: CanNaturalCatch
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	local v24 = v_u_3.Mutations[p22]
	if not v24 or v24.Chance <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	if v24.DateRange then
		local v25 = DateTime.now()
		local v26 = v24.DateRange.Start
		local v27 = v24.DateRange.End
		if v25.UnixTimestampMillis < v26.UnixTimestampMillis or v25.UnixTimestampMillis > v27.UnixTimestampMillis then
			return false
		end
	end
	if p23 == "_appraisal_" then
		if v24.BlockAppraisal then
			return false
		end
	else
		if p22 == "Lunar" and not workspace:GetAttribute("MoonlitMirageActive") then
			return false
		end
		if p23 == "_wormhole_" and v24.BlockWormhole then
			return false
		end
		if p23 ~= "_wormhole_" and (v24.SpecificZones and not table.find(v24.SpecificZones, p23)) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

					continue

			end

				end
			end

				break
			end

				v28[v36] = (v28[v36] or 0) + v30.AllStatsPercent
			end
		end

			if typeof(v39) ~= "number" then
				continue
			end

			else
				p23[v37] = p23[v37] * (v38 / 100 + 1)
			end
		end

	end,
	["UpdateDescriptions"] = function(p40) -- name: UpdateDescriptions

				v41._DescriptionTemplate = v41.Description
			end
			v41.Description = v_u_1:Format(v41._DescriptionTemplate, v41)
		end
	end,
	["GetRichDisplayName"] = function(p42, p43) -- name: GetRichDisplayName

			return p43
		end
		local v45

			v45 = require("../../utils/FischUtils").GradientRichText(v44.Display, v44.ColorGradient)
		else
			v45 = ("<font color=\"#%*\">%*</font>"):format(v44.Color:ToHex(), v44.Display)
		end
		if v44.ForceStroke then
			v45 = ("<stroke color=\"#%*\">%*</stroke>"):format(v44.StrokeColor:ToHex(), v45)
		end
		return v45
	end
}

end

			local v4 = p3:FindFirstChild("Stats") and p3.Stats:FindFirstChild("rod")
			if v4 then
				v4 = p3.Stats.rod.Value
			end
			local v5 = (v4 == "Marrow Rod" or v4 == "Terrotrapper") and true or v4 == "Masterline Rod"
			if v5 then
				local v6 = p3.Stats:FindFirstChild("bobber")
				if v6 then
					v6 = p3.Stats.bobber.Value
				end
				if v6 == "Sand Sifter" then
					return true
				end
			end
			local v7 = p2.Data.NewFormat.Rods[v4]
			local v8 = v5 and "You\'ll need to equip the <b>Sand Sifter</b> bobber to fish here." or "Your current rod can\'t catch anything here..."
			if not (v4 and v7) then
				return false, v8
			end
			if v7.keeperboundActive then
				if v7.keeperboundAffixes and table.find(v7.keeperboundAffixes, "Sifting") then
					return true
				end
			elseif v7.secondaryEnchant == "Dune" then
				return true
			end
			return false, v8
		end

	["ExclusiveRods"] = nil,

	["Priority"] = 106,
	["CantBeWormholed"] = true,

	["ExclusiveRods"] = {

		"Mistletoe Minnow",
		"Carol Carp",
		"Reindeer Ray",
		"Elf Eel",
		"Nutcracker Catfish",
		"Fruitcake Flounder",
		"Bauble Bass",
		"Bellfin",
		"Jolly Bait Crate",
		"Present",
		"Snowy Present",
		"Santa\'s Present",
		"Merry Manta Ray",
		"Santa Whale Shark",
		"Northstar Whale",
		"Festive Relic",
		"Cryoshock Serpent"
	},
	["CustomCondition"] = function(p37, p38, p39) -- name: CustomCondition
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		if p37:GetAttribute("CanCatchCryoshock") and v_u_1.world.weather.meteorological.Value == "Frost Moon" then
			local v40 = p39:FindFirstChild("Stats")
			if v40 then
				v40 = v40:FindFirstChild("rod")
			end
			if v40 then
				local v41 = p38.Data.NewFormat.Rods[v40.Value]
				if v41 then
					if v41.enchant == "Merry" or v41.enchant == "Gingerbread" then
						return true
					elseif v41.secondaryEnchant == "Peppermint" then
						return true
					else
						return false, "Your rod lacks the magic of Fischmas..."
					end
				else
					return false, "Your rod lacks the magic of Fischmas..."
				end
			else
				return false, "Your rod lacks the magic of Fischmas..."
			end
		else
			return false, "You have not yet awakened the serpent."
		end
	end
}

		return {}
	end

				if typeof(v68) ~= "number" then

			end
		end
		return v66
	end
	local v69 = require("../../SharedKeeperEnchant").GetPowerLevelMultiplier(p61, v64)
	local v70 = v_u_4.copy(v_u_6:GetCurrentBoosts(v65.keeperboundEnchant, p61, v69), true)
	if v65.keeperboundAffixes then

		end

if v1:IsServer() then
	local v_u_16 = workspace.active.boats
	local v_u_17 = v_u_2.events
	local v_u_18 = workspace.world.boatspawns
	local v_u_19 = {}
	local _ = {
		Color3.fromRGB(126, 59, 59),
		Color3.fromRGB(74, 74, 74),
		Color3.fromRGB(63, 70, 94),
		Color3.fromRGB(78, 102, 75),
