	function v_u_13.PurchaseValidityCheck(_, p20, p21) -- name: PurchaseValidityCheck
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_13, (ref) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_8
		local v22 = os.time()
		local v23 = v_u_13.library[p21]
		if not v23 then
			return false, "Unknown boat!"
		end
		local v24 = v_u_11(p20)
		if not v24 then
			return false, "Please wait a moment..."
		end
		if not v24:FindFirstChild("Boats") then
			return false, "Please wait a moment..."
		end
		if v23.ExpirationDate and v23.ExpirationDate.UnixTimestamp < v22 then
			return false, "This boat has expired!"
		end
		if v23.LimitedAmount then
			local v25 = v_u_8.Server:GetReplion("LimitedStockItems")
			if not v25 then
				return false, "Failed to check stock! Please try again later."
			end
			if v25:GetExpect({ "Stocks", p21 }) <= 0 then
				return false, "This boat is out of stock!"
			end
		end
		return true
	end
	function v_u_13.OnBoatProductPurchase(_, p26, p_u_27, p28) -- name: OnBoatProductPurchase
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_13, (ref) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_8
		local v29 = os.time()
		local v30 = v_u_13.library[p_u_27]
		if not v30 then
			return false
		end
		local v31 = v_u_11(p26)
		if not v31 then
			return false
		end
		if not v31:FindFirstChild("Boats") then
			return false
		end
		if v30.ExpirationDate and v30.ExpirationDate.UnixTimestamp < v29 then
			return false
		end
		if v30.LimitedAmount and not p28 then
			local v32 = v_u_8.Server:GetReplion("LimitedStockItems")
			if not v32 then
				return false
			end
			if v32:GetExpect({ "Stocks", p_u_27 }) <= 0 then
				return false
			end
			task.spawn(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_27
				local v_u_33 = require(game:GetService("ServerScriptService").server.legacyServices.LimitedStockService)
				local function v34()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_33, (ref) p_u_27
					return v_u_33:DecreaseStock(p_u_27, 1)
				end
				local v35, v36 = pcall(v34)
				if not v35 then
					warn((("Failed to reduce stock: %*"):format(v36)))
				end
			end)
		end
		v_u_13:Give(p26, p_u_27)
		return true
	end
	function v_u_13.Give(_, p37, p38, p39, p40) -- name: Give
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_17
		local v41 = p39 or 1
		if v41 <= 0 then
			return false
		else
			local v42, v43 = v_u_11(p37)
			if v42 and v43 then
				local v44 = v42:FindFirstChild("Boats")
				if v44 then
					if v_u_13.library[p38] then
						local v45 = v44:FindFirstChild(p38)
						local v46
						if v45 then
							local v47 = v45.Value
							v46 = tonumber(v47) or 0
							local v48 = v46 + v41
							v45.Value = tostring(v48)
						else
							local v49 = Instance.new("StringValue")
							v49.Name = p38
							v49.Value = tostring(v41)
							v49.Parent = v44
							v46 = 0
						end
						local v50 = v_u_17:FindFirstChild("anno_give_boat")
						if not p40 and (v50 and v50:IsA("RemoteEvent")) then
							v50:FireClient(p37, p38, v41, v46 + v41)
						end
						return true
					else
						warn((("Unknown boat \"%*\" given to %*!"):format(p38, p37.Name)))
						local v51 = v43.Data.NewFormat.FailedRewards
						local v52 = {
							["Type"] = "Boat",
							["Name"] = nil,
							["Amount"] = nil,
							["Time"] = nil,
							["Name"] = p38,
							["Amount"] = v41,
							["Time"] = os.time()
						}
						table.insert(v51, v52)
						return true
					end
				else
					local v53 = v43.Data.NewFormat.FailedRewards
					local v54 = {
						["Type"] = "Boat",
						["Name"] = nil,
						["Amount"] = nil,
						["Time"] = nil,
						["Name"] = p38,
						["Amount"] = v41,
						["Time"] = os.time()
					}
					table.insert(v53, v54)
					return true
				end
			else
				return false
			end
		end
	end
	function v_u_13.Ungive(_, p55, p56) -- name: Ungive
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10
		local v57 = v_u_10(p55)
		if not v57 then
			return false
		end
		local v58 = v57:FindFirstChild("Boats")
		if not v58 then
			return false

function v42.DynamicOptions(p44) -- name: DynamicOptions
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_32
	local v45 = require("./modules/SharedPlayerStats")
	local v46 = require("./modules/SharedDataHelper")
	local v47 = {}
	for _, v48 in v_u_2 do
		if not v48.SubstatKey or (v48.Id == "fishCaught" or v48.Id == "mutatedCaught") then
			continue
		end
		local v49 = {}
		for v50 in v46.indexNewFormatNow(p44, { "NewStats", v48.SubstatKey }) or {} do
			table.insert(v49, v50)
		end
		table.sort(v49)
		for v51, v52 in v49 do
			local v53 = ("%*/%*"):format(v48.Id, v52)
			v47[v53] = {
				["Id"] = v53,
				["Name"] = v45.GetSubstatName(v48.Id, v52),
				["Order"] = v_u_32[v48.Id] + v51
			}
		end
	end
	return v47
end

		return v74.indexNewFormatNow(p73, { "PlayerList", "ForcedBackgrounds", p72.Id }) ~= nil
	end
	local v75 = v_u_4[p72.Id]
	if v75 then
		return v75.Role ~= nil and require("./modules/PlayerListData").Get(p73, v75.Role) == true and true or v74.indexNewFormatNow(p73, { "PlayerList", "CardBackgrounds", p72.Id }) == true
	end
	local v76 = v_u_3[p72.Id]
	return not v76 or (v76.AutoDiscover == true and true or v74.readLegacyPathNow(p73, { "Stats", "tracker_locationsdiscovered", (("%*Discovered"):format(p72.Id)) }) ~= nil)
end

		if v_u_123 == p133 then

		elseif v_u_123 == p134 then

	end

end

			v_u_20 = { ... }

function CreateBody(p78, p79) -- name: CreateBody

		v81[v82] = { v83[1] * p79, v83[2] * p79 }
		local v84 = v81[v82][1] ^ 2 + v81[v82][2] ^ 2
		local v85 = math.sqrt(v84)
		if v_u_80.Radius >= v85 then
			continue
		end
		v_u_80.Radius = v85
	end
	local v_u_86 = v81
	v_u_80.RadiusSq = v_u_80.Radius * v_u_80.Radius
	function v_u_80.GetPoints(_) -- name: GetPoints
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_86, (copy) v_u_80
		local v87 = {}

			local v90 = v_u_80.Rotation
			local v91 = math.sin(v90)
			local v92 = v_u_80.Rotation

			v87[v88] = { v_u_80.X + v89[1] * v93 - v89[2] * v91, v_u_80.Y + v89[2] * v93 + v89[1] * v91 }
		end
		return v87
	end

end

function CollidePointWithLevel(p127, p128, p129, p130) -- name: CollidePointWithLevel
	local v131 = {}
	local v132 = {}
	for _, v133 in pairs(p127.Terrain) do
		if p130 and not p130[v133] then
			continue
		end
		local v134 = p128 - v133.CenterX
		local v135 = p129 - v133.CenterY
		if v134 * v134 + v135 * v135 >= v133.RadiusSq then
			continue
		end
		local v136 = (1 / 0)
		local v137 = nil
		local v138 = 1
		for _, v139 in pairs(v133.Axis) do
			local v140 = p128 * v139.DirX + p129 * v139.DirY
			if v140 < v139.Min or v139.Max < v140 then
				v137 = v139
				v136 = 0
			else
				local v141 = v139.Max - v140
				local v142 = v140 - v139.Min
				if math.min(v141, v142) >= v136 then
					continue
				end
				if v141 < v142 then
					v137 = v139
					v136 = v141
					v138 = 1
				else
					v137 = v139
					v136 = v142
					v138 = -1
				end
			end
		end
		if v136 <= 0 then
			break
		end
		local v143 = #v131 + 1
		v131[v143] = v137
		v132[v143] = v136 * v138
	end
	if #v131 <= 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local v144 = 0
	local v145 = 0
	for v146 = 1, #v131 do
		local v147 = v131[v146]
		local v148 = v132[v146]
		v144 = v144 + v147.DirX * v148
		v145 = v145 + v147.DirY * v148
	end
	return v144, v145
end
function CollideBodyWithLevel(p149, p150) -- name: CollideBodyWithLevel
	local v151 = {}
	for _, v152 in pairs(p149.Terrain) do
		local v153 = v152.CenterX - p150.X
		local v154 = v152.CenterY - p150.Y
		if v153 * v153 + v154 * v154 >= (v152.Radius + p150.Radius) ^ 2 then
			continue
		end
		v151[v152] = true
	end
	if next(v151) then
		local v155 = p150:GetPoints()
		local v156 = 0
		local v157 = 0
		local v158 = false
		for _, v159 in pairs(v155) do
			local v160, v161 = CollidePointWithLevel(p149, v159[1] + v156, v159[2] + v157)
			if not v160 then
				continue
			end
			v156 = v156 + v160
			v157 = v157 + v161
			v158 = true
		end
		if v158 then
			return v156, v157
		else
			return nil
		end
	else
		return nil
	end
end

function v_u_38.SwapCategory(p150) -- name: SwapCategory
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_6
	local v151 = not (p150 and v_u_8:FindFirstChild(p150)) and "Rods" or p150
	local v152 = v_u_8:FindFirstChild(v151)
	for _, v153 in pairs(v_u_8:GetChildren()) do
		if not v153:IsA("ScrollingFrame") or v153 == v152 then
			continue
		end
		v153.Visible = false
	end
	v152.Visible = true
	v_u_6.rodtitle.Text = "Crafting [" .. v151 .. "]"
end
